title: German-Speaking Video Editor (Full Time) - Short Form Ads, VSLs & Static Ads
description:
We run a German e-commerce brand. Our ads are what sell the product, so creative is the core of the business - not a side task.



I am looking for ONE person, full time, long term, who owns our creative output: short form ads, VSLs and static image ads.



TWO THINGS MATTER MOST. Everything else I can teach.



1. YOUR GERMAN

You must read and write German at a level where you can spot a bad sentence.

Not Google Translate. Not "I studied a little". If a German caption or headline sounds off, you have to feel it. One wrong word on a static kills the whole ad.



IF YOU DO NOT SPEAK GERMAN - READ THIS

I know how few people in the Philippines speak German. So here is your door, and it is a real one:

If you believe you would do this job better than a German speaker, tell me why. Not "I am a fast learner" - give me something I can judge. Maybe you have already produced German or other foreign language ads for a client and you have the numbers. Maybe you have a system for working in a language you do not speak and it has held up. Maybe your editing is simply on another level and you are already learning German.

Write me a few honest sentences about it. I read every single one.

But know what you are up against: the German speaker does not have to convince me of anything.



2. YOU THINK FOR YOURSELF

I do not want someone who sits and waits for a brief.

I want someone who watches what our competitors are running, has an idea on Tuesday morning, builds it, and shows it to me on Wednesday. Someone who says "I want to try this angle" and then tries it. Someone who notices that a certain topic keeps getting comments and makes three more videos about it without being asked.

If you need a storyboard for every single video, this is the wrong job. If you want to test your own ideas with a real ad budget behind them, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



Short form ads (15-60s)

- Edit from B-roll, stock, UGC and AI footage

- Hooks, captions, pacing, sound - the full cut



VSLs (1-3 min)

- Build long form sales videos from a script and a voiceover

- Keep 15-20 shots moving so nobody scrolls away



Adapting English videos into German

- Swap the voiceover, rebuild every caption, re-time every cut to the new audio

- The result has to look like it was made in German, not translated into it



Static image ads

- Design 1:1 and 4:5 ads from product photos, lifestyle shots and before/after images

- Set German headlines that are readable on a phone at scroll speed

- Build variations of a winner: same layout, new headline, new image

- Clean up supplier images - remove foreign text, fix labels



Your own stuff

- Bring me ideas. New angles, new hooks, new topics, formats you have seen working somewhere else.

- A part of your week is yours to test what you believe in.



OUTPUT PER WEEK

4-6 finished videos and 8-10 statics, ready to upload. At least one of them your own idea.



WHAT I GIVE YOU

- Scripts, raw footage, product photos, brand assets, voiceover tool access

- Clear briefs when it matters and freedom when it does not

- Fast feedback, usually the same day

- Stable full time work, paid monthly, no project hopping

- Real ad spend behind your ideas, and the numbers back so you see what worked



TOOLS

CapCut or Premiere for video, Photoshop, Canva or Figma for statics. Your choice, as long as the output is clean.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Send 2-3 videos you edited yourself and 2-3 static ads you designed yourself. One line each on what YOU did.

2. One paragraph about your German: how good it is, where you learned it, and what you have already produced in German.

   If you do not speak German, write the honest paragraph I asked for above instead.

3. Tell me about one video or ad that YOU came up with yourself - not on anyone's brief. What was the idea, and how did it go?

4. Put the word SCHNITT in your subject line so I know you read this.



Applications without points 2 and 3 I do not read.

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR (ECOMMERCE ADS) | LONG-TERM | PAID TRAINING + ECOM TALENT COURSE
description:
FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR (ECOMMERCE ADS) | LONG-TERM | PAID TRAINING + ECOM TALENT COURSE



READ THIS FIRST

We only review applicants who fill out our application form (link at the bottom).

We don't answer OJP messages. If you skip the form, we won't see your application.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small, fast-growing ecommerce company running two brands: one sold in

Europe and one sold in the US. Every month we spend serious money on
 and

Instagram ads, and video ads drive most of our growth.



Our team is small, remote and stable. Everyone on it has been with us for 1.5 years or

more. We don't hire for projects. We hire people we want to keep for years.



THE ROLE

You'll edit video ads for both brands, full time.



- Each week you get clear written briefs with the script, the hooks, reference ads and

  notes on exactly what to make.

- You turn each brief into finished ads, usually in several versions (different hooks,

  different lengths) so we can test what works.

- You work next to our current editor, so you're never figuring things out alone.

- You see the results. We run every ad and track which ones win, and part of your pay

  is tied to that.



Some of our ads are in German. You don't need to speak it: every German ad comes with

an English version of each line.



WHAT YOU GET

- Paid training: $7/hour for your first 14 days (about $1,200/month full time).

- After training: $8/hour (about $1,390/month).

- Performance bonus on top, based on the ads you produce. We share the details during

  the interview.

- Full access to eCom Talent, the most elite video ad editing course in ecommerce,

  paid for by us. You'll learn hooks, retention, pacing, statics and AI tools: the

  reasons ads work, which most editors are never taught.

- Room to grow. We run two brands, both growing, and we promote from within. Editors

  who understand why ads win move into bigger roles.

- A long-term home: full time, remote and stable.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Hunger matters more to us than your current level. If you're already great, amazing.

If you're good and determined to become great, we built this role for you.



You're a fit if:

- This will be your ONLY job. Full time, no school, no side clients. We mean this.

- You want to stay somewhere for years, not months.

- You're strong in CapCut and have a portfolio of short vertical videos (ads, TikToks,

  Reels, UGC).

- You know what a hook is and why the first 3 seconds d
 everything.

- You take feedback well and fix things fast.

- You have a reliable computer and stable internet.



Bonus points:

- You've edited paid ads for ecommerce brands.

- You've used HeyGen, Google Flow or other AI video tools.



HOW WE WORK

- Flexible hours, with a few hours of overlap each day with our team in Europe.

- A team meeting every two weeks. Attendance is mandatory.

- Briefs come in through Trello, you deliver in Google Drive, and we talk on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Fill out this form: 

2. In the form, include a Loom video (5 minutes max). Introduce yourself, show 2 or 3

   videos you're proud of, and walk us through how you made one of them.

3. Type the words HOOK FIRST as your first answer in the form. This shows us you read

   the whole post.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

1. We watch every Loom that comes in through the form.

2. Shortlisted editors get a call with us. Ask us anything, this goes both ways.

3. Final candidates get a test brief: a real ad brief, about 3 to 4 hours of work. The

   test is unpaid. If you're the editor we're looking for, you'll enjoy it.

4. We hire one editor, who starts with the 14-day paid training.

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
description:
Chief of Staff to the CEO (Remote, Philippines-based)



OPA is a group of healthcare companies in Atlanta, Georgia: home care, skilled nursing, and healthcare staffing. We are a small team and we are growing quickly. I am the founder and majority owner. I am hiring a chief of staff to be my right-hand person. I have founded and built several successful companies, and you will work with me on building this one and the others that follow. There will be opportunities for promotion for the right person.



THE JOB

A company cannot see its own problems. Somebody has to look at the work, compare it to the standard, and say plainly what they found. As my chief of staff, you do that for me across every part of the business.



You will:

- Track every commitment my managers make to me and follow each one until it is done or I drop it.

- Read the weekly financial and operating reports before I do and tell me what is wrong with them.

- Tell a manager, in writing, when a report or plan does not meet the standard, and why.

- Tell me when I am wrong, in writing, with the facts, before I d
.

- Prepare my meetings and close them out with who owns each item and the date it is due.

- Draft memos, policies, and correspondence for my review.



WHO SUCCEEDS IN THIS JOB

You are an exceptional communicator. You are diligent about your work. And you are a bulldog: once you are given something, you do not let go of it until it is finished and finished right.

You love coaching and growing people, and you know what that takes. Coaching means telling someone exactly where their work falls short of the standard, showing them what meeting it looks like, and checking the next piece of work, as many times as it takes. It is hard and often harsh. Growing people takes constant attention to that coaching.



WHO FAILS IN THIS JOB

Most of this job is conversations other people would rather not have. If you prefer to wait for a better moment, soften a finding until it stops saying anything, reply "noted" when you disagree, or report a missed deadline after it is missed, this job will be miserable for you.



I am also not looking for someone who enjoys arguing. The disagreements here are about whether work meets a standard and what something costs the company. Nothing else is worth my time or yours.



HOW WE WORK

I make the final decision. Your job is to make sure every material fact is in front of me when I make it, especially the ones nobody wanted to bring me. Once I d
, you carry it out. If new facts appear, you bring them back.

If you are behind, you tell me before the deadline.

If you raised something and nothing happened, you raise it again.

Most of your working day falls in US Eastern business hours. Some weeks run well past forty hours.



WHAT YOU NEED

- An MBA, a JD, or a comparable graduate degree.

- Excellent written English. Most of this job happens in writing.

- An operational understanding of sales and accounting, the two essential disciplines in business. You can read a profit and loss statement and a payroll report and find the line that does not belong.

- Experience reporting problems to people senior to you and getting them fixed: operations, audit, consulting, finance, legal, or project management.

- US healthcare, payroll, or billing experience helps but is not required.



PAY

USD 2,500 per month. Full-time and long-term.



HOW TO APPLY

No cover letter. Answer these three questions in writing, in under 600 words total. Applications that skip a question will not be read.

1. Describe a time you told someone senior to you that their work or decision was wrong. What did you say, what did they do, and what happened next? If they overruled you, what did you do after that?

2. A manager tells you a project is on track. The numbers you have show it will miss its date by three weeks. The manager has been with the company eight years and is well liked. You report to the CEO. Write the exact message you would send, and say who receives it.

3. Which part of this job post is weakest, and why?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid work sample and a live interview.

title: Quality Assurance/Registered Nurse
description:
Position Summary

OPA Home Care operates a strict, gated Referral-to-Cash Operating System (v2.2) designed to deliver consistent outcomes regardless of who executes the process. Every stage has one owner, binary “done” definitions recorded in AxisCare, mandatory QA audits, and clear KPIs. OPA has maintained a perfect shift coverage record – zero missed shifts since May 23, 2024. As our Quality Assurance & Operations Administrator, you will execute daily audits, enforce gate compliance, and produce reporting that keeps the pipeline running with discipline and integrity. You will own the audit function across all active pipeline stages and escalate violations without delay.



Important: This role involves reviewing client records that may contain Protected Health Information (PHI). HIPAA training is required and must be completed before AxisCare access is granted. No exceptions.



Key Responsibilities

Core QA & Audit Ownership



• Perform the full Stage 1 QA Audit within 24 hours of every Referral ? Intake completion – verifying lead entry timestamps, contact cadence, SLA execution while client is on the phone, deposit calculation and posting, gate integrity, referral source entry in both required AxisCare locations, and Director of Operations start authorization.

• Expand QA audits to additional stages (Intake ? Care Plan, Staffing, Visit Completion, Billing, and Recruiting pipeline) as those stages are finalized and directed.

• Track stage completion misses by employee and stage. Support corrective action by reporting misses to the task owner and Director of Operations within 24 hours of identification.

• Own the Exception Tracking Protocol: confirm every gate bypass is logged with all four required fields (exception type, reason, approved-by, normalization deadline) and normalized by the applicable deadline – 24 hours for emergency starts, 48 hours for gate overrides. Escalate missed normalizations immediately.

• Run weekly cross-pipeline reviews and support root-cause analysis when lag KPIs fail.

• Deliver daily audit summaries and weekly pipeline reports to the Director of Operations, CEO, and designated team members. Flag gate violations immediately – no batching of critical issues.



Operations Support

• Monitor AxisCare continuously for gate integrity, status accuracy, medically fragile designations, documentation compliance, and system rule adherence.

• Enforce core system rules without exception: one owner per stage, no downstream action before gate confirmation, “if it is not logged in AxisCare, it did not happen,” and no informal modifications.

• Support scheduling, intake, clinical, and billing teams with repeatable administrative and auditing tasks as directed by the Director of Operations.



Compliance & Reporting

• Maintain strict HIPAA compliance in all work involving client data, at all times.

• Produce clear, accurate, and timely audit reports and documentation.

• Participate in process improvement as the company scales and additional OS stages are activated.



Success Metrics

• 100% of assigned QA audits completed within required timeframes.

• 100% of exceptions normalized by deadline or escalated with documented reason before deadline.

• Zero unaddressed critical issues in audit reports – all gate violations flagged same day.

• Reporting delivered on schedule with no gaps.

• Contribution to overall pipeline KPIs: conversion rates, shift coverage, collection rates.



Qualifications

• Must be an RN(required) 

2+ years of experience in quality assurance, process auditing, operations coordination, or healthcare administration. Home care, BPO, or healthcare support experience is a strong advantage.

• Demonstrated attention to detail and documented ability to enforce strict processes and rules – including escalating when colleagues are non-compliant.

• Strong proficiency with EMR/EHR or care management systems. AxisCare experience is highly preferred; fast independent learners will be considered.

• Excellent written and spoken English – clear, professional, and precise in all communications.

• Reliable high-speed internet, power backup, and a quiet dedicated workspace for US night-shift hours.

• Experience with HIPAA or equivalent data privacy standards. Candidates without prior HIPAA experience must complete comprehensive training before system access is granted.

• Comfortable working independently with a high degree of self-direction while coordinating with a US-based team via Slack,
, and scheduled calls.



Preferred

• Background in home care, senior care, or healthcare BPO operations.

• Experience creating structured audit summaries and operational reports.

• Familiarity with US healthcare compliance environments or payer operations (VA, Medicaid, private pay).



Compensation & Benefits

• Monthly salary: $1,200 USD. Performance bonus bridges toward higher earnings for strong and consistent performers.

• Paid training on OPA’s Operating System, AxisCare, and HIPAA – completed before system access is granted.

• Opportunity to grow into expanded audit and operations scope as the company scales.



Why Join OPA?

You will play a foundational role in protecting a rigorous, systems-driven operation that delivers exceptional reliability to clients and families. OPA has maintained zero missed shifts since May 23, 2024 – a record this role directly protects. If you are process-oriented, thrive on detail and consistency, and want to contribute to a growing US home care company while working remotely from the Philippines, this role is built for you.

title: Marketing and Customer Growth Lead
description:
Marketing and Customer Growth Lead

CoinPort Exchange, 

Remote, Philippines based. Full time.



Grow a regulated Australian crypto exchange from the ground up. You own the creative and the results. Our compliance team signs off before anything goes live, because that is what being regulated means.



- 100% work from home, no commute ever

- 36 hours a week, not the usual 48

- Every second Friday off, so a long weekend every fortnight



ABOUT COINPORT



CoinPort is an AUSTRAC registered Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) based in Melbourne, Australia. We run a regulated AUD crypto exchange, built to do things properly in a space that often doesn't.



We are a lean team that takes compliance seriously. We need someone to take marketing off the founders' plates and turn it into a real growth engine, starting in Australia. A move into the Philippines may follow later, subject to local licensing.



Everyone here runs their own station. There is no hand holding and no bureaucracy. If a blank canvas excites you rather than worries you, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



The role is roughly 80% marketing and 20% customer contact. You report to our Operations Manager and work closely with our CEO on marketing direction.



Marketing (about 80%)

- Marketing strategy for the Australian market, with you setting the direction

- Paid ads on Google, Meta and crypto relevant platforms, managing your own monthly budget

- Social media end to end: content calendar, copy, design briefs, scheduling and community replies

- On camera video: explainers, promos and social reels

- Brand consistency across every CoinPort touchpoint

- Tracking results, cutting what doesn't work and reporting weekly

- Preparing every ad and post for compliance review before it goes live



Customer contact (about 20%)

- Chat and phone support for Australian customers

- Welcoming new users and walking them through onboarding and identity checks

- Following up with people who get stuck partway through signup



Talking to customers every day is the best market research you will get.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 90 DAYS



- A marketing plan for Australia, agreed with the CEO

- Google and Meta ad accounts approved for crypto advertising and running live campaigns

- A steady weekly posting rhythm across our main social channels

- At least four short videos published, with you on camera

- A weekly report covering signups, verified users and first deposits

- Faster onboarding, with fewer new users stalling before their first deposit



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on camera and on the phone with Australian customers.

- Confident on camera, and able to explain crypto clearly to a first time buyer

- Comfortable speaking with customers by phone

- Able to run ads and social campaigns without an agency

- A genuine interest in crypto, fintech or financial services. You don't need to be a trader, but you need to care about the space.

- Self directed, with a track record of owning something and growing it

- Happy working in a small team where everyone has a wide remit

- Bonus: experience marketing to Filipino audiences



COMPENSATION AND HOURS



Base pay: AUD $2,000 per month

Bonus: Performance linked, tied to the goals above

13th month pay: Included, paid every December

Equipment: Allowance provided

Hours: 36 a week, averaged over a fortnight

Schedule: 8 hours a day, Monday to Thursday every week, plus Friday every second week

Time zone: Hours overlap with Melbourne business hours, around 6am to 2pm Manila time during Australian daylight saving and 7am to 3pm otherwise

Location: 100% work from home in the Philippines

Engagement: Contractor to start, moving to a staff role after a successful trial period, with length to be agreed



Pay grows when results do. No six day weeks and no commute, ever.



HOW TO APPLY



We read every application. Send these four things to 
 with the subject line "Marketing and Customer Growth Lead: [your name]".



1. A 60 to 90 second intro video in English. Tell us who you are, why crypto marketing interests you, and show us your camera presence. A simple selfie video is fine. If you speak Tagalog, a second version in Tagalog is a welcome bonus.

2. Your best marketing work. Links to campaigns, social accounts you've managed, content you've made, or results you're proud of. Any industry counts. If you've grown your own following, share that too.

3. A time marketing made a real difference. What was the situation, what did you do, and what happened as a result?

4. Your CV. What you've built and shipped matters more to us than a degree from years ago.



Applications without the video or the written answer won't progress. That's not us being strict. This role is communication first.



What happens next: shortlisted applicants are invited to a video call, followed by a short paid task and a final interview with the founders.

title: Outbound Calling VA (Healthcare) – Verify Software + Book Demo Calls
description:
Outbound Calling VA (Healthcare) – Verify Software + Book Demo Calls



About Qira



We own 3 multi‑location dental practices in Orange County, CA and built Qira, a tool on top of Dentrix Ascend that drafts visit notes and creates patient follow‑up tasks so fewer patients fall through the cracks. We’re now looking for 1–2 rock‑solid outbound callers to help us identify the right practices and book demos for our founder.



Role Overview



Your job: call dental offices in the US, confirm which practice‑management software they use, collect the right contact details, and warm them up for a short demo with our founder. You are a setter, not a closer. You follow the script, handle objections, stay positive when people hang up, and keep the sheet/CRM spotless. Cold outreach is volume + consistency, not vibes.



What You’ll Do (Daily)



• Make 150–200 outbound calls per day to dental practices during US business hours.  

• Ask 2–3 simple questions to:  

• Confirm their practice‑management system (Dentrix Ascend or not).  

• Identify the decision maker (doctor/office manager).  

• Collect direct
 + best phone number.  

• Briefly explain that we run 3 Dentrix Ascend practices and built Qira to help with notes and follow‑ups, and check if they’re open to a short demo later with our founder.  

• Log every call result accurately in our CRM (PMS used, contact name,
, interest level, notes).  

• Tag “hot/warm” leads and hand them off for demos.  

• Join a short daily huddle to report dials, connects, and qualified contacts.



Requirements



• Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent. Very comfortable on the phone with US professionals.  

• 1+ year of experience in phone‑based roles: outbound sales, customer support, appointment setting, or collections.  

• Comfortable being hung up on, told “no,” and calling the next day again without losing energy.  

• Able to follow a script exactly, while still sounding human.  

• Strong note‑taking and data entry.  

• Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and a good headset.  

• Available 4–8 hours/day during US Pacific working hours, Monday–Friday.



Nice to Have



• Experience calling US medical or dental offices.  

• Experience with tools like Google Sheets, HubSpot, Apollo, Instantly, or any dialer/VoIP.



KPIs



• Dials per day  

• Verified Dentrix Ascend practices per day  

• New decision‑maker contacts collected per day  

• “Interested/open to demo” handoffs



How to Apply (Follow These Steps Exactly)



Submit your proposal on this platform with:



1. Proposal Title  

   Dentrix Setter – [Your Name]



2. Loom Video (Required, Camera ON)  

   Record a 2–3 minute Loom with your face visible, talking normally (no script, no AI). In the video, cover all of this:



• Who you are and where you’re based  

• Your phone/outbound experience and typical daily dials/KPIs  

• How you handle being hung up on or rejected all day  

• What you understand about sales (in your own words)  

• What makes you better than other people at sales/calling  

• The biggest thing you’ve learned about selling or persuading people on the phone



   Paste the Loom link in your proposal.



3. Short Written Answers (in your proposal text)  

• What outbound calling / sales roles have you done before, and what were your exact daily KPIs?  

• What time window can you work in US Pacific time (example: 9am–1pm PST, Mon–Fri)?



Applications without a Loom video, or where you’re clearly reading or using AI, will be ignored.

title: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator
description:
Position: Architectural Stone CAD Drafter & Estimator



We are seeking an experienced CAD drafter and estimator who can transform architectural plans, designer renderings, elevations, and field measurements into accurate, fabrication-ready shop drawings for natural stone projects.



The ideal candidate understands natural stone slabs, wall cladding, flooring, countertops, large-format panels, fireplaces, exterior façades, and custom architectural stonework.



Primary Responsibilities



* Review architectural plans, designer renderings, specifications, and field measurements.

* Create detailed 2D and 3D shop drawings for client approval and fabrication.

* Develop elevations, sections, details, dimensions, joint locations, anchoring details, and installation layouts.

* Prepare slab-layout drawings showing how each piece will be cut from full slabs.

* Determine the number of slabs required for each project.

* Create accurate material takeoffs, cut lists, piece schedules, and square-foot quantities.

* Optimize slab usage to reduce waste while maintaining proper color and vein continuity.

* Lay out book-matched, vein-matched, and sequentially installed stone when required.

* Identify missing dimensions, conflicts, and constructability issues before fabrication.

* Coordinate drawing revisions with designers, architects, estimators, fabricators, and installers.

* Maintain organized drawing files, revision records, and project documentation.

* Assist the estimating department with labor, material, waste, and fabrication requirements.



Required Experience



* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD.

* Experience with SketchUp, Revit, Rhino, SolidWorks, or another 3D modeling platform.

* Previous drafting or estimating experience in natural stone, tile, countertops, architectural cladding, millwork, metal fabrication, glazing, or a similar fabrication industry.

* Ability to read architectural and structural plans.

* Strong understanding of dimensions, tolerances, joints, substrates, installation conditions, and fabrication limitations.

* Ability to calculate square footage, linear footage, piece quantities, slab requirements, and waste factors.

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience creating natural-stone shop drawings and slab-cutting layouts.

* Experience with Slabsmith, Moraware, AlphaCAM, EasySTONE, or similar stone-industry software.

* Knowledge of marble, granite, quartzite, limestone, travertine, and thin natural stone veneer.

* Understanding of vein direction, slab sequencing, book matching, dry layouts, and material variation.

* Experience creating CNC-ready information is a plus.

* Familiarity with exterior cladding, mechanical fastening, adhered veneer, and large-format stone installation is highly desirable.



Required Work Samples



Applicants must provide examples of:



* AutoCAD shop drawings

* Architectural elevations and details

* Slab layouts or cutting diagrams

* Material takeoffs or cut lists

* Relevant 3D models or renderings



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who combines drafting ability with practical fabrication and estimating knowledge. This person should understand not only how to draw the project, but also how the stone will be selected, cut, matched, fabricated, delivered, and installed.

title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot/GHL, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot/GHL reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be confident in learning platforms, checking integrations, and spotting data inconsistencies.



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have strong English communication skills, especially in written updates and documentation.

• Are detail-oriented and can spot inconsistencies in data, reports, workflows, and CRM records.

• Are tech-savvy and comfortable learning tools like HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow.

title: HR & People Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded and people-focused HR & People Manager to lead and strengthen the people function at Cosy Hauz.



This is a strategic yet hands-on role, responsible for ensuring we have the right people, structures, processes and culture in place to support our continued growth.



Working closely with the COO, CEO and leadership team, you will take ownership of the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding to performance management, employee engagement, learning and development, and HR governance.



We are looking for someone who can think ahead, take initiative and turn ideas into action. Beyond managing HR processes, you will play a key role in shaping our workplace culture, developing our people and ensuring our company values, particularly Growth Mindset, are reflected in everything we do.



Key Responsibilities



Recruitment & Workforce Planning

- Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, from workforce planning and candidate sourcing to selection and onboarding.

- Build a strong talent pipeline aligned with the company's values and business needs.

- Work with department heads to identify staffing requirements and plan for future growth.



HR Policies, Governance & Compliance

- Develop, review and continuously improve HR policies, procedures and internal processes.

- Ensure HR practices comply with applicable employment legislation and company policies.

- Conduct regular HR audits, maintain accurate documentation and identify opportunities for improvement.



Performance Management

- Lead the company's performance appraisal and evaluation processes.

- Work with managers to establish clear performance expectations, KPIs and development objectives.

- Support performance improvement initiatives and promote accountability across teams.



Employee Engagement & Relations

- Develop and implement initiatives that improve employee engagement, satisfaction and retention.

- Manage employee relations matters with fairness, professionalism and confidentiality.

- Promote open communication and proactively address workplace concerns.



Culture & Values

- Strengthen and maintain a positive, collaborative and high-performing workplace culture.

- Embed Cosy Hauz's core values, particularly Growth Mindset, throughout the employee experience.

- Encourage continuous improvement, accountability, teamwork and professional growth.



Learning & Development

- Identify training needs and employee capability gaps.

- Develop and coordinate relevant learning, training and professional development programmes.

- Support managers in developing their teams and building leadership capabilities.



Benefits & HR Administration

- Oversee employee benefits, HR documentation and administrative processes.

- Maintain accurate, organised and confidential employee records.

- Ensure employees receive timely and effective HR support throughout their employment.



HR Reporting & Strategic Partnership

- Monitor and analyse HR metrics, including recruitment, retention, attendance, engagement and performance.

- Provide actionable insights and recommendations to support workforce efficiency and business decisions.

- Partner closely with the COO and leadership team to anticipate organisational needs and implement practical HR solutions.



Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field.

- Minimum of 3–5 years of progressive HR experience, with demonstrated ownership across multiple HR functions.

- Proven experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management, HR policies and employee engagement.

- Good understanding of employment legislation, HR compliance and organisational governance.

- Experience developing, implementing and improving HR policies and procedures.

- Experience managing performance appraisal processes, employee benefits and HR administration.

- Strong communication, interpersonal, organisational and problem-solving skills.

- Confidence in working with senior management and supporting organisational decisions.

- Proficiency in HR systems, Microsoft Office and other workplace productivity tools.



What We're Looking For

- Strategic & Commercially Minded: You understand how people decisions contribute to productivity, business performance and long-term growth.

- Proactive & Accountable: You take initiative, anticipate challenges and follow through on commitments.

- Hands-On & Resourceful: You are equally comfortable developing strategies and executing day-to-day HR responsibilities.

- People-Centred: You genuinely care about employee wellbeing, development and building a supportive workplace.

- Confident & Decisive: You exercise sound judgement, communicate clearly and are comfortable challenging ideas constructively.

- Growth-Minded: You are adaptable, open to feedback and constantly looking for ways to improve.

- Resilient & Organised: You can manage competing priorities and remain effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.



What Success Looks Like



In this role, you will help build an HR function that is structured, proactive and aligned with the company's long-term goals.



Success means creating an environment where employees understand their expectations, managers are equipped to lead effectively, HR processes are dependable, and company values are consistently reflected in everyday decisions.



Most importantly, you will become a trusted partner to leadership, helping Cosy Hauz develop a capable, engaged and high-performing workforce.



Why Join Cosy Hauz?



At Cosy Hauz, we believe that building a successful business starts with developing great people.



You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership of the HR function, work closely with senior leadership and make a meaningful impact on how our organisation grows.



We value initiative, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. We are looking for someone who shares these values and is excited to help shape the next stage of our company's development.



If you're passionate about people, driven by continuous improvement and ready to build something meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Job title: Senior AI Automation Engineer (n8n, APIs, Claude/GPT, Shopify, Odoo) (Full-time)

About us

Automation backbone: production-grade workflows in n8n (or Make) connecting our tools, with error handling, logging and monitoring.

Sales reconciliation: end-to-end tracking from Meta Ads to WooCommerce/Shopify to Odoo, to measure real ROAS on cash actually collected (COD).

Integrations: Meta Marketing API and Conversions API, Shopify and WooCommerce APIs, Odoo (XML-RPC/JSON-RPC), Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business.

AI agents: Claude and GPT-based agents for ad monitoring, landing page checks, product research, reporting and anomaly detection.

MCP connectors: let the founder query and pilot operations in natural language from Claude.

Documentation & ownership: every workflow documented, every account in the company's name, and handover-ready at all times.



Must have



4+ years building automations in production (n8n, Make or Zapier at advanced level)

Strong API skills: REST, webhooks, OAuth, JSON, plus JavaScript or Python for custom nodes and scripts

Hands-on experience with Shopify or WooCommerce, and with the Meta Ads API or Conversions API

Real projects with LLMs (Claude and/or OpenAI): agents, prompt chains, tool use

A portfolio of live workflows you can show and explain

Excellent written English, autonomous and reliable



Strong plus



Odoo integration experience

MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers

COD e-commerce, or MENA / Gulf markets

Self-hosting (Docker, VPS) for n8n



How we hire



Application: subject line "EMPIRE-AI-SENIOR – [Your Name]", plus:

3 automations you built in production (what, stack, result)

Your availability and expected monthly rate

Loom (3–5 min): walk us through one of your real workflows, including the logic, error handling and what you would improve.

Paid diagnostic (fixed fee): analyze our Meta, WooCommerce and Odoo setup and propose a reconciliation architecture.

Paid trial (2–4 weeks): build the first version, then move to a full-time contract.



Applications without the Loom or with only tutorial-level projects will not be considered.

title: YouTube & Short-Form Video Editor with Creative Storytelling Skills
description:
Remote | Part-time | Ongoing work



Hi! I’m Eva, a London-based creator, entrepreneur and mum of three. My content explores cultural experiences, interesting activities and events, family adventures, and my journey building small businesses.



I’m looking for a talented video editor who can turn my footage and ideas into engaging YouTube videos, Shorts and Instagram Reels.



Creative thinking is essential. You should enjoy finding the strongest hook, shaping a story and suggesting ways to make a video more compelling.





What you’ll do



- Edit YouTube videos from footage of experiences, activities and events, as well as talking-to-camera videos.



- Develop strong openings and a clear story flow that keeps viewers interested.



- Add relevant B-roll, captions, text, music, sound effects and visual effects where they improve the video.



- Improve audio, colour and pacing for a polished, natural result.



- Identify strong moments from YouTube videos and turn them into standalone Shorts and Reels, with their own hooks and satisfying endings.



- Edit separately filmed vertical videos to make them more engaging.



- Suggest hook options, story angles and, over time, short scripts or talking points.



- Flag missing footage or narration and suggest what I should record to complete the story.



I like engaging edits with personality, humour and thoughtful pacing. Effects should support the story and suit the moment.





Who I’m looking for



- A portfolio showing both YouTube videos and short-form content.



- Strong storytelling skills: you can recognise what is interesting in raw footage and build a video around it.



- Good written and spoken English, including the ability to write natural hooks and accurate captions.



- Confidence suggesting ideas and explaining your creative choices.



- Reliability, clear communication and an organised approach to files and deadlines.



- Openness to feedback and the ability to apply what you learn to future videos.



- Experience using an video editing tool.



-Experience in creating covers for youtube videos



- Experience editing personal creator content, cultural or travel videos, vlogs, or talking videos would be especially relevant.





How we’ll work together



-Initially, we’ll work closely so you can learn my voice, audience and preferences. I’ll share footage, reference videos and a short written or voice-note brief.



-As we build a working relationship, I’d like you to take increasing ownership of hooks, structure and creative suggestions, with less detailed direction from me and be more proactive.





Workload and payment



- We will start with a trial period with the agreed payment and total hours of work.  

- After trial period we will establish a regular, long-term part-time role.

- Please share your availability and rate.



Paid trial



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid trial using footage I provide. This will involve suggesting two hook options and editing a 60–90-second video so we can assess storytelling, editing style and communication.



We’ll agree on the fee and scope before you begin.



How to apply



Please send to 
 



A brief introduction and why this role interests you.



Two or three relevant portfolio examples, including at least one YouTube video and one Short/Reel. Explain your contribution to each.



Your editing software, availability and usual turnaround time.



Your rates as outlined above.



A short answer to this question: “If I send you footage from an interesting cultural event without a script, how would you find the hook and shape the story?”



I’m looking for someone who enjoys contributing ideas and would like to grow with a creator over time.



Looking forward to seeing your work!



Eva

High school level topics include mechanics, thermal and nuclear Physics, electricity, waves, gravity, electromagnetism, quantum Physics, special relativity, and cosmology.



Who would thrive in this role?



You enjoy solving Physics problems, explaining your reasoning, and getting the details right.



We welcome applicants from a range of backgrounds:



- Science and STEM graduates or professionals with strong Physics knowledge.

- Maths graduates who can confidently apply their problem-solving skills to high school Physics.

- Experienced teachers who enjoy writing questions and explaining concepts to students.

Across all backgrounds, we’re looking for strong high school Physics knowledge, excellent written English, and the ability to produce accurate, easy-to-follow solutions. You’ll also need good organisational skills and availability for full-time remote work.



Why join our team?



- Put your strengths to work: Build a role around your subject knowledge, writing, and problem-solving skills.

- Make a practical difference: Create resources that help students in Australia learn and succeed.

- Work remotely with daytime hours: Enjoy a consistent weekday schedule with no night shifts.

- Build a long-term career: Join a supportive international team, with opportunities to progress into senior or departmental roles based on performance.



Pay and working arrangements



Location: Remote / online

Commitment: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30 am–5:30 pm, Perth / Philippine time (GMT+8)

Salary: USD $650+ per month, depending on qualifications and experience



Sound like a fit? Apply today.

We’re looking for someone who takes pride in clear explanations and quality work - and wants to grow with us.

title: Onboarding & Client Success Specialist (Part-time)
description:
ABOUT US

Pure Proposals is a PandaDoc Premier Partner. We run onboarding for new PandaDoc customers and build proposal and quoting systems for businesses in the US, Australia and Europe. We're a small, fast team and we use AI across everything we do.



THE ROLE

You'll start by leading onboarding launch calls with new PandaDoc customers. On each call you're the expert in the room. Customers come with questions about how PandaDoc works and how to set it up for their business, and your job is to guide them with confidence.



As you settle in, the role grows. You'll become part of our team helping with client success, account management, sales support and workflows across the business.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Run onboarding launch calls with new PandaDoc customers

2. Answer questions on how PandaDoc works and point customers to the right features for their business

3. Follow up after each call with notes, answers to anything you took away, and next steps

4. Keep records up to date in Salesforce, HubSpot, and ClickUp

5. Support existing clients with questions and check-ins (client success and account management)

6. Help with sales tasks such as replying to enquiries, booking calls and preparing follow-ups

7. Help run and improve our workflows and automations



TRAINING AND SUPPORT

We'll train you properly on PandaDoc before your first call, and keep supporting you after. A lot of this work is nuanced and you won't know every answer, especially early on. That's fine. What matters is being comfortable saying to an onboarding client "great question, leave that with me and I'll come back to you," and then doing it.



HOW WE WORK

We use Claude (AI) across the business. You'll use it to turn call transcripts into follow-up
s, notes and task lists, so the admin after each call takes minutes, not hours.



WHAT YOU NEED

1. Excellent spoken and written English

2. Proven customer service or client success experience with software customers 2+ years

3. Experience running onboarding or training calls for a software platform 2+ years

4. Confidence leading a call with a customer who expects you to know the product



HIGHLY FAVOURED

1. Prior PandaDoc experience

2. Experience with similar tools such as DocuSign, Proposify, HubSpot or Salesforce

3. Experience in account management or sales support

4. Experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your work



HOURS AND PAY

~20 hours per week and growing, CEST timezone hours. Long term for the right person, with more hours as the role grows. The role is hourly pay, contracted. 



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip any step won't be reviewed)

1. Start your application message with the words "PandaDoc Onboarding" so we know you read this.



2. In writing, detail your customer service experience: which companies, which software or products, how long, and what a typical day looked like - DO NOT JUST SEND GENERIC RESUME OR CV, PLEASE CUSTOMISE A TAILORED INTRODUCTION LETTER



3. Include a link to a video of NO MORE THAN 2 MINUTES (Loom, YouTube unlisted or Google Drive) answering these three questions:

   a. What software have you onboarded customers onto, and what did a typical onboarding call look like?

   b. Tell us about a time a customer asked something you didn't know. What did you say, and what happened next?

   c. Have you used PandaDoc or a similar tool? Which ones?





THE FINE PRINT



- This is an independent contractor role, not employment. Paid monthly in USD on the contracted hours you track.

- The first 90 days are a trial period, with a review at the end.

- You'll need your own computer, a stable internet connection and a backup for power or internet outages. (VERY GOOD internet connection is critical, since you'll be on video calls with clients)

- Calls are mostly in CEST timezone, so you'll need to be available around those hours. 



Thank you, we are looking forward to reviewing your profile!

title: Crypto BD Lead Wanted: Turn DeFi Contacts Into Booked Calls, Get Paid Per Call + Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. description:
# Job Title: Auto Rental Operations & Sales Specialist

**Company:** Auto Rental Business  

**Fleet Size:** 30 Vehicles  

**Position Type:** Full-Time  

**Work Arrangement:** Remote  

**Industry:** Automotive / Vehicle Rentals / Customer Service



## About the Company



We are a growing auto rental company managing a fleet of 30 vehicles. We are looking for a reliable, organized, and sales-driven professional to manage incoming rental inquiries, qualify prospective customers, close rental deals, oversee payment collections, and assist with daily fleet operations.



The ideal candidate is proactive, comfortable communicating with customers, skilled at following up with leads, and focused on maximizing bookings while minimizing missed payments, unpaid tolls, and vehicle downtime.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Lead Management & Sales

- Respond promptly to leads generated through
 and Instagram (Meta) advertisements.

- Communicate with prospective customers through
 Messenger, WhatsApp, phone calls, text messages, and
.

- Follow up consistently with interested prospects until they book or decline.

- Qualify leads, answer questions, explain rental terms, and overcome common objections.

- Convert inquiries into confirmed rental reservations and maximize the percentage of leads that become paying customers.

- Maintain a professional, friendly, and persuasive communication style.

- Track all leads, conversations, follow-ups, bookings, and lost sales in a CRM or tracking spreadsheet.

- Follow up with previous customers to encourage repeat rentals and referrals.



### 2. Customer Screening & Verification

- Vet prospective renters before approving a rental.

- Collect and verify required identification, driver's license, driving history, and other documents according to company policy.

- Review eligibility requirements, rental history, payment information, and any required background or driving-record checks.

- Identify suspicious applications, inconsistent information, potential fraud, and other red flags.

- Ensure all required documents and agreements are completed before vehicle release.

- Escalate questionable applications or exceptions to management before approving a rental.

- Maintain customer confidentiality and securely handle sensitive documents.



### 3. Payment Management & Collections

- Monitor rental payments and ensure customers pay on schedule.

- Send payment reminders before due dates and follow up immediately on overdue balances.

- Track weekly rental payments, deposits, outstanding balances, late fees, and other approved charges.

- Contact customers whose payments have failed or whose balances remain unpaid.

- Maintain an accurate payment ledger for all 30 vehicles.

- Reconcile payment records against the company's payment processor and bank records.

- Escalate delinquent accounts and potential contract violations to management.

- Never issue refunds, waive fees, or change payment terms without authorization.



### 4. Weekly Toll Management

- Review toll accounts and transactions at least once per week.

- Match toll charges to the correct vehicle, customer, and rental period.

- Maintain a log of tolls incurred during each customer's rental.

- Notify customers of toll charges and collect payment according to the rental agreement.

- Track unpaid tolls, administrative fees, disputed charges, and unresolved transactions.

- Follow up until outstanding toll balances are resolved.

- Flag toll violations, repeated unpaid charges, and suspicious activity for management.



### 5. Fleet & Rental Operations

- Maintain an updated tracking sheet for all 30 vehicles, including availability, current renter, rental dates, payment status, and maintenance needs.

- Coordinate vehicle pickups, returns, extensions, and reservation scheduling.

- Send rental agreements, payment instructions, and pickup or return information to customers.

- Track upcoming reservation end dates and contact renters about renewals or returns.

- Coordinate routine maintenance, oil changes, tire replacements, inspections, repairs, and detailing.

- Monitor vehicle downtime and help get vehicles back into service quickly.

- Track mileage, vehicle condition reports, keys, documents, registration, and insurance expiration dates.

- Report accidents, breakdowns, damage, overdue returns, and other operational issues promptly.



### 6. Customer Service & Retention

- Handle customer questions, complaints, rental extensions, and billing concerns.

- Communicate company policies clearly and professionally.

- Help resolve issues before they turn into negative reviews or lost customers.

- Request reviews and referrals from satisfied customers.

- Maintain a customer database for repeat business and future marketing opportunities.



### 7. Reporting & Accountability

- Provide daily updates on new leads, bookings, collections, and unresolved issues.

- Prepare a weekly report covering:

  - Number of incoming leads and rentals closed.

  - Lead conversion rate and reasons for lost sales.

  - Payments received and overdue balances.

  - Toll charges collected and outstanding.

  - Fleet utilization and vehicle availability.

  - Maintenance issues and vehicles out of service.

  - Upcoming rental expirations and customer follow-ups.

- Keep all company records organized and up to date.

- Identify opportunities to increase rental revenue, improve customer service, and streamline operations.



## Required Qualifications

- Previous experience in auto rentals, car dealerships, vehicle fleet management, sales, collections, or customer service.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong sales, negotiation, and follow-up skills.

- Experience handling
 and Instagram advertising leads.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets, Excel, WhatsApp,
, and CRM systems.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple customers, deadlines, and payment schedules.

- Trustworthy, self-motivated, responsive, and able to work independently.

- Willingness to take ownership of results rather than wait for instructions.



## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with rental management software or fleet management systems.

- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite,
 Messenger, and Instagram lead management.

- Experience with payment processors, toll accounts, and customer collections.

- Knowledge of rental agreements, driver screening, vehicle maintenance scheduling, and fleet utilization.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses and customers.



## Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be evaluated on:

- Speed and quality of responses to new leads.

- Number of qualified leads converted into paying rentals.

- Accuracy and completeness of renter documentation.

- On-time payment collection and reduction of overdue balances.

- Weekly toll reconciliation and collection follow-through.

- Accuracy of fleet records and scheduling.

- Customer satisfaction, repeat bookings, and professionalism.

- Consistent reporting and proactive problem-solving.



## How to Apply

3. The tools and software you have used to manage leads, customers, payments, or vehicles.

title: Community Engagement & Social Media Role
description:
Hi there,



We are The Equine Practice Company (TEPC).  We’re a global education business providing advanced continuing professional development (CPD/CE) for equine veterinarians.



We also operate Horse Health HQ (HHHQ), a second brand in the similar space that supports horse owners or other people who work with horses (and not vet qualified)



We are currently hiring a full-time Community Engagement & Social Media Manager to help us build active, helpful and engaged online communities across TEPC and Horse Health HQ.



Your number one responsibility will be community engagement: starting conversations, encouraging members to ask questions, helping members interact with one another, sharing useful information and making our communities places people genuinely want to visit every day.



You will also publish content across our social media platforms. However, you will not be expected to create the content for this function of your role. Your leader will provide you with a regular supply of professionally created posts, graphics, videos and promotional material. Your job is to make sure it gets published consistently and correctly.



This is not a general VA role.



This is a focused role responsible for ensuring our social platforms remain active, professional, and credible - reinforcing TEPC and HHHQ as trusted authorities in equine veterinary education.



Why This Role Matters

We don't want our
 groups to simply be places where we broadcast content. We want them to become genuine communities.



Places where horse owners and veterinarians feel comfortable asking questions. Places where members share their experiences and help one another. Places where interesting conversations happen every day.



Your job is to help make that happen.



You might start the day by asking an interesting question, welcome someone who has posted for the first time, find a useful horse-health tip to share, encourage members to contribute to a discussion, or notice an unanswered question and help get the conversation moving.



If you love getting people talking and making online communities feel alive, this could be a great role for you.



Important Clarification

You do not need to be a veterinarian, and you will not be expected to provide veterinary or clinical advice. We have veterinarians on our team who can answer clinical questions when required.



Your job is to facilitate the conversation, not be the clinical expert. You need to recognise when something should be passed to one of our veterinarians rather than trying to answer it yourself.



Your Core Responsibilities

You will manage content output across:

-

- Instagram

- LinkedIn

- YouTube

- Google Business Profile

1. Content Publishing & Platform Consistency

- Schedule and publish high-quality posts a few times a day on our pages/platforms

- Ensure consistent brand voice across TEPC + HHHQ

- Maintain an organised content calendar

- Educational posts

- Graphics and carousels

- Short-form videos

- Stories

- Program announcements

- Expert/speaker content

- Customer reviews



Your responsibility is to schedule and publish this content consistently across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and Google Business Profile. 



2. Community Manager

Your most important responsibility will be helping our online communities become active, useful and welcoming.

Each day you will:

- Start interesting conversations.

- Ask questions that horse owners genuinely want to answer.

- Encourage members to ask their own questions.

- Respond to members and ask follow-up questions to keep conversations going.

- Notice unanswered posts and help get other members involved.

- Research useful horse-owner tips and information to share.

- Welcome and encourage new members.

- Identify interesting member discussions that could become future content.

- Encourage members to share their experiences with one another.

- Escalate clinical questions to our veterinary team when appropriate.



Success in this role means our communities don't feel like noticeboards. They feel alive.



3. Coordination With Our Team

You will work closely with our brand associate (who is based in the Philippines and recently promoted from this role within 6 months of joining the organisation) to receive:

- Content direction

- Clinical topics

- Speaker highlights

- Promotional priorities



Your role is execution, consistency, and output.



Who This Role Is For:

You may be perfect for this role if you:

- Naturally enjoy talking to people online.

- Are good at asking questions that get people talking.

- Enjoy making people feel welcome and included.

- Are curious and enjoy researching useful information.

- Notice when somebody's question has been ignored and want to help.

- Can keep a conversation going without forcing it.

- Have excellent written English.

- Are organised enough to make sure our scheduled social content goes out every day.

- Can work independently without constantly being told what to do next.

- Confidence starting and maintaining online conversations.

- Strong research skills.

- Good judgement when dealing with questions and comments.

- Highly organised and reliable.

- Comfortable using
, Instagram and other major social platforms.



Nice to Have (Bonus Skills)

 Groups or online communities.

- Experience in the horse/equestrian industry.

- Experience in veterinary, medical, education or health communities.

- Experience with social media scheduling tools.

- An understanding of how to grow engagement organically.



Work Structure

Full-time (40 hours/week)

Remote

Long-term role

Expected starting pay: Php30,000 pesos/week (happy to pay more if you can prove your experience)



Application Test (Required)

title: PERFORMANCE GRAPHIC DESIGNER — STATIC AD

title: YouTube Growth Strategist — Titles, Thumbnails, Analytics & A/B Testing
description:
LOCATION: Remote — Philippines

TYPE: Part time, long term

HOURS: Approximately 15 hours per week

PAY: $5 USD per hour, plus monthly performance bonuses of up to $75. Bonus criteria will be agreed before work begins.



ABOUT THE ROLE



I’m Christy Love, a comedian, podcast host, and content creator. I publish three types of YouTube content weekly:



• Church sermons

• Lifestyle vlogs

• Holy Sheet with Christy Love podcast episodes



I’m looking for an analytical, methodical YouTube growth strategist who can also create effective thumbnails and titles.



You should be able to identify the strongest angle in a video, develop a clear hypothesis about what will attract the intended audience, test that hypothesis, and use the results to guide future decisions.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Review each upcoming video or transcript to identify its strongest hook and viewer promise.

• Understand the different audiences for sermons, vlogs, and podcast interviews.

• Research relevant channels and unusually successful videos to identify useful patterns.

• Develop approximately five title options and three distinct thumbnail concepts per video.

• Design and deliver the thumbnails, explaining how each title and image work together.

• Set up and monitor native YouTube A/B tests where available.

• Maintain a testing log documenting the hypothesis, variations, results, and next steps.

• Analyze impressions, click-through rate, traffic sources, watch time, and audience retention.

• Evaluate results in context, recognizing that traffic sources, audience size, and video topics affect performance.

• Recognize inconclusive results and avoid declaring winners without sufficient evidence.

• Provide a concise weekly report with findings and actionable recommendations.

• Apply lessons from completed tests to upcoming videos.



INITIAL SCOPE



The initial workload is three new videos per week: one sermon, one vlog, and one podcast episode.



We will not update titles or thumbnails on previously published videos. This role focuses on upcoming uploads and testing those videos after publication.



Additional future projects may become available, with hours and compensation discussed before expanding the scope.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Hands-on experience managing YouTube growth, analytics, and title or thumbnail testing.

• A portfolio of thumbnails you personally created.

• Strong English writing skills and experience developing titles for a U.S. audience.

• Ability to explain your decisions using both creative reasoning and data.

• Understanding of how titles and thumbnails influence clicks, and how the video must deliver on their promise.

• A structured, organized approach to research, testing, reporting, and deadlines.

• Proficiency with YouTube Studio and Photoshop, Canva, or comparable design software.



Experience with personality-led channels, podcasts, lifestyle content, or faith-based content is a plus.



CREATIVE APPROACH



My brand is modern, playful, personal, and candid. My audience is primarily adults, and I want to attract more women while continuing to serve existing viewers.



Each content category needs its own approach. Sermons should connect with meaningful questions and struggles. Vlogs should highlight a compelling story. Podcasts should emphasize the strongest guest insight or conversation.



Titles and thumbnails must accurately represent the content. Curiosity is welcome; misleading claims are not.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE EVALUATED



We will consider the quality of your strategy and designs, reliable delivery, disciplined testing, and documented improvements.



Total views alone will not determine performance. You should be able to explain what the data supports, what remains uncertain, and what you recommend testing next.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with STRATEGY FIRST and include:



1. YouTube channels you have worked on and your specific responsibilities.

2. Three examples of title and thumbnail combinations you developed.

3. One A/B test case study: your hypothesis, what you tested, the results, and what you learned. Remove confidential information.

4. Your process for reviewing a video and selecting its strongest hook.

5. How you would investigate a video with high click-through rate but low watch time.

6. The tools you use and your weekly availability.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial with an agreed scope, time limit, and payment.



I’m looking for a thoughtful, dependable collaborator who brings ideas, follows a clear process, and turns analytics into better creative decisions.
