title: Full-Time Short-Term Rental Operations & Pricing VA (Guesty Experience Required)
description:
APPLY HERE: 

We only review applications sent through this form. Messages sent through OnlineJobs won't be read.



FULL-TIME SHORT-TERM RENTAL OPERATIONS & PRICING VA (GUESTY EXPERIENCE REQUIRED)



About us

We're a UK-based short-term rental company managing serviced accommodation. Our properties are listed on Airbnb, 
 and other OTAs, as well as corporate and contractor booking sites such as Blueground.



About the role

You'll work directly with our director and run the day-to-day operations of our properties. Pricing and listings are the biggest part of this job, because that's where our revenue comes from.



Please read this part carefully: we need someone who already knows Guesty and dynamic pricing well. This is not a training role. You should be able to start contributing from your first week, spot problems before anyone points them out, and make decisions within your role without waiting to be told.



Schedule

Monday to Friday, 12pm to 8pm UK time, 40 hours a week.

Weekends are not part of the role. Occasionally we may ask for weekend cover, but this will always be agreed with you in advance.



Pay

USD $800 per month, paid monthly. This is an independent contractor role.



Start date

Late November 2026.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Pricing and listings

- Own day-to-day pricing in Guesty using our dynamic pricing tool (currently Guesty PriceOptimizer), combining automated pricing with manual adjustments

- Check pricing every working day and keep all rates up to date

- Review our current pricing setup and recommend improvements

- Optimise our listings across OTAs and contractor sites: descriptions, photos in the right order, and every detail correct

- List new properties and connect them to Guesty

- Make sure Guesty, our pricing tool and our connected channels are set up and working properly



Guests and operations

- Handle guest messages across all platforms, plus booking requests and payments (including chasing declined payments)

- Send access codes and take inbound calls from guests, booking platforms and contractors

- Keep property managers and cleaners updated on guest requests such as early check-in or late check-out

- Log maintenance jobs and coordinate them with contractors, letting agents and property managers

- Leave guest reviews and flag any issues raised in reviews

- Arrange guest relocations when needed



Admin and landlord support

- Manage the director's inbox and CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Track leads and follow up with landlords, and support onboarding admin for new properties

- Landlord invoicing, and filing invoices and expenses

- Monthly KPI reports and owner performance reports using our templates

- Meeting notes, spreadsheets and general admin for the director

- Join some business coaching sessions and clinics with the director, or on his behalf



How we work

WhatsApp is our main way of communicating. During your shift, you'll need to respond promptly and answer calls from the director. You'll also send a short daily check-in covering what you did, any issues and your priorities for the day.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Must have

- Proven, hands-on experience using Guesty (daily use, not just familiarity)

- Experience with dynamic pricing tools such as Guesty PriceOptimizer or PriceLabs, including making manual pricing adjustments

- Experience in short-term rental or serviced accommodation operations

- Excellent written and spoken English, and comfortable on calls with UK clients

- Takes ownership and works independently: you don't wait to be told what to do

- Reliable internet with a backup, a quiet workspace and your own equipment

- Available for the full shift, Monday to Friday



Nice to have

- GoHighLevel

- Experience with UK properties or guests

- Experience with corporate let or contractor booking platforms



This is a full-time role, and we need someone who can give it their full attention during working hours. If you're currently juggling several clients at the same hours, this probably isn't the right fit.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through the form at the top of this post. It takes about 10 minutes and includes one short pricing scenario. Please answer in your own words. We read every answer, and copy-pasted or AI-written answers won't move forward.



If you haven't used Guesty before, please don't apply for this one.

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER



Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD / month (Base) + Aggressive Annual Performance Bonus tied to KPI achievement 

Remote | Full-time | 



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 🎸⚡️



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage). 

Website: 

: 



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take

end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two

category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories.

Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog

expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings. You are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will

make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line

expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars,

external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1. P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership

• Commercial Accountability: Own the Amazon channel P&L end-to-end, steering margin health,

revenue velocity, and net contribution.

• Cost & Margin Decomposition: Deeply analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee

structures (FBA fulfillment, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and overall contribution margin

to inform pricing and operational decisions.

• Capital & TACoS Allocation: Determine and allocate target TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales)

percentage points across specific product lines and ad formats to maintain healthy profitability while

unlocking incremental growth.



2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.)  High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.)  Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.)  Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.)  Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume  & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

- One specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and

scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******



• Base Salary: $3,500 to $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale

managed.

• Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and

growth KPIs.

• Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Distributed team.

• Impact & Ownership: High degree of executive autonomy over a substantial, mature $20M business

line with direct exposure to brand leadership.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥

title: Video Editor / Graphics Designer

You’ll be the creative engine that turns briefs into polished short-form videos and eye-catching graphics that drive engagement and growth. You work from the direction and briefs provided by our Social Media Manager / creative lead. Your job is to bring them to life.

- Graphic Design: Design static graphics for posts, promotional materials, and visual assets.

- Technical Production: Handle the full production workflow: color grading, sound design, transitions, and effects.

Experience



- Mid-level background in video editing and design, preferably in the education or lead-gen sectors.

- Strong understanding of how short-form video performs for both paid and organic.

- A portfolio that proves you can create scroll-stopping, engaging content.



Volume Expectations



- 3 to 5 pieces of content per day (video and graphics combined) during the testing period.

- Consistent quality and brand alignment across all work.

- Flexible turnaround based on content complexity.



You’re the Right Fit If



- You can work U.S. PST hours

- You’re a creative powerhouse who switches seamlessly between editing and design.

- You’re fast and efficient, turning around polished content quickly without sacrificing detail.

- You’re self-sufficient with technical execution (sound, color, effects).

- You understand how short-form performs across paid and organic.

- You’re organized, detail-oriented, and thrive in a collaborative startup.



What We Provide



- Access to Canva Pro, Capcut Pro, and other editing software/tools as needed

- Creative briefs and direction from the Creative Lead / Social Media Manager.

- Brand guidelines and content strategy.

- A collaborative startup environment where your work directly impacts growth.



What We Offer (Full-Time)



- Competitive salary (negotiable by experience)

- 13th-month pay, internet allowance, U.S. holiday leave

- HMO, PhilHealth, SSS, Pag-Ibig after probation

- Paid sick leave and time-off

- Pay increase possible after 6-month probation based on performance

Please use the code DreamTeam when applying. Submit your resume, your portfolio (especially short-form content), and a brief note about your creative process and how you work from briefs.

title: Video Editor – Motorsport YouTube Channel – Long-Term Weekly Work – AUD $100/Week
description:
VIDEO EDITOR – MOTORSPORT YOUTUBE CHANNEL

LONG-TERM WEEKLY WORK – AUD $100/WEEK



Hateley Motorsport is an Australian grassroots speedway race team with an established YouTube channel.



I am looking for ONE reliable video editor for ongoing weekly work.



This is not a flashy agency-style editing job.



The goal is to take my raw race-night footage and get each weekly YouTube video approximately 80% finished so I can do the final cleanup, intro/outro, racing-specific corrections and upload.



BUDGET



AUD $100 per week.



This is the fixed target budget for one weekly long-form video.



Please DO NOT apply if your normal price is several hundred dollars per video.



If the relationship works well and the channel/business grows, the rate can be reviewed later.



THE FOOTAGE



A normal race meeting may include:



- 2 to 3 GoPro cameras

- Full race footage from each camera

- Usually 2 heat races plus a feature/final

- Phone footage from the pits

- Short talking/vlog clips

- Repairs, setup changes and general race-night footage



There may be several hours of raw footage in total.



The GoPros often record the same race from multiple angles, so I need someone comfortable with syncing and working with multicam footage rather than treating every camera as a separate video.



YOUR JOB



For each weekly video I want you to:



- Organise the footage

- Sync GoPro camera angles

- Create multicam sequences where appropriate

- Watch through the race footage and identify the useful moments

- Choose sensible camera angles

- Remove dead/unnecessary footage

- Arrange the vlog/pit footage into a logical story

- Build an approximately 8–20 minute long-form YouTube video

- Do basic audio levelling

- Add simple text/titles/placeholders where useful

- Deliver the Premiere project and an approximately 80%-finished edit



I will then do the final pass myself.



STYLE



Please look at the existing Hateley Motorsport YouTube channel before applying:







The style is grassroots motorsport / race-day vlog.



I do NOT want excessive memes, constant zooms, giant animated captions or over-edited TikTok-style effects.



Good pacing and storytelling are much more important than fancy effects.



SOFTWARE



Adobe Premiere Pro is strongly preferred because I want to be able to open and continue working on your project files.



After Effects knowledge is useful but NOT required.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



I am happy to work with a junior or intermediate editor.



You do not need to be a Hollywood editor.



I care more about:



- Reliability

- Understanding long-form YouTube

- Being able to sort large amounts of footage

- Good basic storytelling

- Following instructions

- Meeting a weekly deadline

- Being interested in motorsport, cars or action sports



TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following.



Do not send a generic cover letter.



1. What editing software do you use?



2. Can you work in Adobe Premiere Pro and send me the Premiere project files?



3. Are you comfortable working through 2–5+ hours of raw multicam GoPro and phone footage each week?



4. Are you comfortable with the fixed budget of AUD $100 per weekly video?



5. Send ONE link to the best long-form YouTube video you personally edited.



Please do not send me 20 portfolio links.



6. Have you edited motorsport, automotive, action sports, racing or similar content before? If yes, send ONE example.



7. Briefly explain how you would handle three GoPro cameras recording the same race.



8. How quickly could you normally return a first draft after receiving the footage?



9. Why does this particular job interest you?



IMPORTANT



If you do not answer the questions above, your application will not be considered.



I would rather find one good person and work together long-term than continually hire different freelancers.



There will likely be a small PAID test edit for shortlisted applicants before I choose the ongoing editor.



Thanks,

Steven

Hateley Motorsport

title: Virtual Assistant for Events & Marketing Coordination in Australia

Applications missing either the Loom video or the CV will NOT be considered.



Summary:

We're a recruitment partner hiring on behalf of an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events.



They need one organised, reliable person to keep each event moving — coordinating vendors, running marketing campaigns, and making sure nothing gets forgotten. You won't be d
 strategy or creative. You'll be the person who makes sure what was d

If you're someone who likes lists, hates loose ends, and quietly enjoys chasing people until they reply, you'll do well here.



What you'll be doing

Six areas, roughly in order of how much time they take:

- Marketing execution —
 and SMS campaigns, social posts,
 Events, and updating event pages on WordPress/Elementor

title: Executive Assistant to the Director | Fast-Growing Property Investment Business
description:

- An updated CV in PDF format.

- Applications missing any of these will NOT be considered.



About us

Charlie Property is a property investment, renovation and flipping business based in Geelong, Australia. Our remote team works across Australia and the Philippines, and we're launching new ventures, including a Buyer's Agency. We celebrate difference: we want people who think openly, speak up and bring a fresh perspective.



The role

You'll be the right hand to our Director. Your job is to protect his time, keep his day organised and make sure nothing falls through the cracks, so he can focus on growing the business.



What you'll be doing

- Inbox and communication: Triage Charles's inbox and the office inbox, draft replies, flag what needs his decision, and follow up until each item is closed. Answer the business phone line.

- Calendar and daily briefings: Manage his business and personal calendar, including appointments, travel blocks and conflicting meetings. Send a short daily briefing so he knows what matters today.

- Live support: Work alongside Charles in our virtual office (body doubling), and join calls during his drive time to work through tasks together.

- Property and partner admin: Connect utilities and insurance for our properties, track settlement dates and other key deadlines, and keep money partners updated on their property's progress.

- Finance and personal admin: Maintain the bills sheet, prepare supplier bills in Xero, handle purchasing, and complete forms, registrations and bookings.

- Grants, awards and SOPs: Find government grants and business awards we qualify for and apply before they close. Document what you do in SOPs and Loom walkthroughs.



What we're looking for

- 3+ years as an Executive Assistant to a founder, director or senior leader

- Strong with numbers and detail, with experience in Xero or similar accounting software

- Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence on the phone with Australian suppliers, utility companies and partners

- Comfortable with Google Workspace, ClickUp and Slack. Using AI tools like Claude to work smarter is a big plus.

- Australian property or real estate experience is a bonus

- The right attitude: you take initiative, communicate proactively, don't need to be chased, and take feedback well. We value attitude over skill.



Hours and engagement

- This is a full-time role that starts part-time: 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, then moves to full-time (40 hours a week) as the role grows.

- You'll work Melbourne business hours (AEST/AEDT).

- Remote, independent contractor. Every candidate completes a paid trial before any offer.

description:

Compensation: $1,200–$2,000/month base + placement-linked bonus

Company: Talent Staffing and Recruiting — a US-based direct-hire staffing firm focused on healthcare/allied-health, expanding into new verticals

Verify us: 
 | LinkedIn: 



JOB OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Recruitment Delivery Manager — a player-coach who owns our open-job board end-to-end and is accountable for filling it. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder.



This is not a sourcing-team or coordinator seat. You take the list of open US jobs, build the fill strategy for each one (sourcing channels, candidate pool, pay-band reality, timeline), personally recruit on the priority searches — sourcing, screening, and submitting candidates yourself — and build and coach a small delivery team as volume grows. You own the number: qualified submittals per week and jobs filled.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Own the open-req board: triage every US job, build a written per-req fill strategy, and keep every req moving or call it honestly.

Personally work the priority desks full-cycle: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit qualified candidates to US clients.

Drive the delivery standard — quality-gated submittals per recruiter per week — with every candidate recruiter-screened before submission, no resume-blasting.

Recruit, onboard, and coach delivery recruiters as the board requires; run the daily delivery cadence and report fill metrics weekly to the founder.

Tell the truth with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



REQUIRED



4+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, including 2+ years leading a delivery team measured on submittals and placements (not a sourcing-only or admin team). US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements you made (role, US state, salary) and walk through how you filled them. There will be a detailed walkthrough in the interview.

Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

Excellent spoken English — you'll screen candidates by phone and coach people who do; there's a live spoken check.

Fluent with an ATS and modern sourcing (job boards, LinkedIn, licensure/credential basics for US healthcare roles).

Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



Do NOT apply if:



Your leadership experience is sourcing/CV-mining teams only (you've never owned submittals-to-fill).

You've only coordinated VMS portals or onboarding paperwork.

You cannot name specific placements you personally closed.

Your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US healthcare professionals, or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: You run the whole delivery engine, not a slice of it — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy and (as volume grows) your own team, competitive base plus a placement-linked bonus so your fills pay you, fully remote, long-term.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



The delivery team you led: company, your title, team headcount, what the team was measured on, and its typical submittals + placements per month. What part did you personally still recruit on?

Name ONE placement you personally closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. (Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)

Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

A US client gives you a hard-to-fill job: CT Technologist in Colorado, 9 candidates already submitted by others, none hired. In 4–6 sentences: your fill strategy, step by step.

Can you commit to a fixed US night shift (~10:00 PM–7:00 AM PHT, US Mountain business hours), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a 30–60 sec voice intro (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

title: Head of Business Development – US Healthcare Recruiting / Direct Hire
description:
We are hiring a Head of Business Development to build and lead client acquisition for our US recruiting firm.



This is a high-ownership leadership role for someone with strong direct hire / permanent placement sales experience in US healthcare recruiting. You will be responsible for building outbound strategy, running discovery calls, closing new client agreements, and managing a small business development team.



About Us



Talent Staffing & Recruiting (TSR) is a US-based direct placement recruiting agency specializing in healthcare clinical leadership, behavioral health, allied health, and specialty imaging.



We work on a 25% direct hire fee model with a 60-day guarantee and operate as an AI-first recruiting company using tools such as Apollo, Clay, Instantly, Manatal, and Claude



What You’ll Do



- Build outbound campaigns targeting US hospitals, behavioral health groups, and healthcare networks

- Run discovery calls with healthcare executives including VPs of HR, COOs, CMOs, and CHROs

- Negotiate and close direct hire fee agreements

- Hire, manage, and develop your BD support team

- Own pipeline performance, team execution, and monthly reporting to the CEO

- Help build an AI-augmented business development engine that scales



What We’re Looking For



- 6 to 10 years of experience in US healthcare BD, executive search, or direct placement sales

- Proven track record of personally closing permanent placement / direct hire agreements

- Experience generating and closing recruiting fee revenue you built yourself

- Strong discovery call and negotiation skills with US healthcare buyers

- 2+ years of team management experience

- Hands-on familiarity with Apollo, Clay, Instantly, Manatal, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Claude, or ChatGPT

- Excellent business English, written and spoken

- Comfortable working permanent night shift



To Apply



Please include:



- Your experience in US healthcare recruiting BD or permanent placement sales

- The types of fee agreements you have personally closed

- Your biggest business development wins

- Your people management experience

- Why you are a strong fit for this role

title: Guest Support Virtual Assistant – Short-Term Rental (Strictly French & English speakers ONLY)
description:
Guest Support Virtual Assistant – Short-Term Rental (Strictly French & English speakers ONLY)

Job Type: Full-Time | Shift-Based | Remote | Philippines



About the Role

We’re a growing short-term rental company looking for a reliable, sharp Guest Support VA to handle all guest communications during their shift. This is a front-line, phone-heavy role. You’re the first person a guest reaches when something goes wrong, and your job is to make it right.



This role is strictly for bilingual candidates who speak and write both French and English fluently. Many of our guests and team members communicate in French, so both languages are a must. Applications from candidates who do not speak French will not be considered.



We’re not filling a seat. We want someone who takes ownership, stays cool under pressure, and communicates with confidence. If you deliver, there’s a clear path to more responsibility and growth within the team.



What You’ll Do



Answer incoming guest phone calls during your shift and handle them live, in French or English

Make outbound calls to guests when needed (follow-ups, check-in issues, urgent updates)

Respond to guest messages across booking platforms

Resolve issues directly when possible, and escalate to the Manager when needed

Log all guest calls, interactions, and reports accurately 

Keep the team informed via Slack and WhatsApp

Flag anything that could impact the guest experience before it becomes a problem



Tools: Guesty, Slack, WhatsApp, Monday, 
, Airbnb, Expedia, and other booking platforms



Requirements



Fluent spoken and written French and English (required, no exceptions)

Confident and professional on the phone, including with frustrated or upset guests

Stable internet connection and a good-quality headset or microphone

A quiet work environment suitable for taking calls

Use “Alpeon” in your application.

Fully available and focused during shift hours

Able to work independently

Previous experience in customer service, call handling, or hospitality is a strong advantage



Schedule: Shift-based, details shared during interview

Full-Time only. Please do not apply if you are looking for part-time.

title: Supply Chain Assistant
description:
Supply Chain Assistant – Order Fulfillment & E-commerce Operations



About the Role:



EVORETRO is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Supply Chain Assistant to support our daily supply chain operations, with a primary focus on order fulfillment, order processing, and shipment monitoring.



The ideal candidate has at least two years of experience in supply chain operations, order fulfillment, logistics, or e-commerce operations. Experience working with online retail businesses and using Cin7 inventory and order management software is highly preferred.



In this role, you will help ensure orders are processed accurately, shipments are monitored, inventory information is maintained, and fulfillment issues are addressed promptly. You will also provide general operational and administrative support to the Supply Chain Supervisor to help keep daily operations organized and efficient.



Key Responsibilities



1. Order Fulfillment and Processing

- Process and monitor daily orders to ensure accurate and timely fulfillment.

- Verify order details, product information, quantities, and shipping information before processing.

- Monitor order status from processing through shipment and delivery.

- Coordinate with warehouses, fulfillment partners, and logistics providers to ensure orders are dispatched on time.

- Identify and follow up on pending, delayed, incomplete, or problematic orders.

- Investigate order discrepancies and coordinate with the appropriate teams to resolve fulfillment issues.

- Maintain accurate order records and update fulfillment trackers and systems.

- Escalate recurring order fulfillment issues to the Supply Chain Supervisor.



2. Inventory and Cin7 Management

- Use Cin7 or similar inventory management systems to monitor orders, stock availability, and inventory records.

- Update and verify order and inventory information in the system.

- Assist in identifying stock discrepancies, low-stock items, and inventory-related fulfillment issues.

- Coordinate with relevant teams regarding product availability and stock concerns.

- Help ensure inventory information is accurate and up to date to support order fulfillment.



3. Logistics and Shipment Coordination



- Assist in coordinating inbound and outbound shipments.

- Monitor shipment schedules, tracking information, and delivery timelines.

- Follow up with logistics providers and fulfillment partners regarding delayed, missing, or incomplete shipments.

- Maintain accurate shipping documentation and tracking records.

- Communicate shipment updates and delivery concerns to the relevant internal teams.

- Help resolve logistics issues that may affect order fulfillment.



4. General Supply Chain Support



- Assist the Supply Chain Supervisor with daily operational and administrative tasks.

- Maintain spreadsheets, reports, order trackers, and supply chain documentation.

- Coordinate with Customer Service, Amazon, and other internal departments regarding order, shipment, and inventory concerns.

- Assist in monitoring pending tasks and following up on outstanding operational matters.

- Identify recurring workflow issues and suggest practical improvements.

- Perform other related duties as assigned to support the Supply Chain Department.



Qualifications and Requirements



- At least 2 years of relevant experience in supply chain operations, order fulfillment, logistics coordination, or a similar role.

- Experience in e-commerce, online retail, or online store operations is highly preferred

- Experience using Cin7 is highly preferred

- Familiarity with inventory management systems, order management platforms, and fulfillment workflows.

- Knowledge of order processing, shipment tracking, stock monitoring, and logistics coordination.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and other productivity tools.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.

- Good written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple orders and priorities while meeting deadlines.

- Proactive in identifying discrepancies, following up on pending orders, and escalating issues when necessary.

- Able to work independently in a remote setup while collaborating effectively with the team.



What We Are Looking For::



We are looking for someone who is hands-on, organized, dependable, and comfortable managing the day-to-day details of order fulfillment.



The successful candidate should be able to monitor orders consistently, maintain accurate records, follow up on outstanding shipments, and coordinate with different teams to ensure orders move smoothly through the fulfillment process.



We value accuracy, accountability, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership over assigned tasks.



How to Apply:



Please submit your updated resume and include a brief summary of your relevant experience, particularly in the following areas:



1. Order Fulfillment: Describe your experience processing and monitoring orders from placement to shipment.

2. Cin7 Experience: Have you used Cin7? If yes, please describe the tasks you handled using the system.

3. E-commerce Experience: What online retail platforms or e-commerce businesses have you supported?

4. Inventory and Logistics: Briefly describe your experience with inventory tracking, shipment coordination, or fulfillment partners.



Please highlight your hands-on order fulfillment experience and the systems you have used in your application.



We look forward to hearing from qualified candidates!

title: Australian Bookkeeper & Financial Analyst (Remote – Philippines)
description:
# JOB TITLE: Australian Bookkeeper & Financial Analyst (Remote – Philippines)



**Job Type:** Full-Time, Part-time, Remote

**Location:** Work from Home – Philippines

**Working Hours:** To be agreed, with some overlap with Australian business hours

**Salary:** Negotiable, based on experience and qualifications

**Start Date:** As soon as possible



## ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a highly organised, analytical, and detail-oriented **Bookkeeper & Financial Analyst** to manage our day-to-day bookkeeping, budgeting, financial reporting, cash flow forecasting, and financial planning.



This role is ideal for someone who understands Australian accounting practices and can do more than simply record transactions. We need someone who can understand the numbers, identify financial trends, help us control expenses, prepare budgets, and provide clear financial reports that support better business decisions.



The successful candidate will work remotely from the Philippines and assist with maintaining accurate financial records, monitoring business performance, preparing forecasts, and coordinating Australian tax and compliance requirements.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, thinks critically, identifies problems before they become serious, and can explain financial information in simple, practical terms.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### 1. Bookkeeping & Financial Records



* Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records.

* Categorise income, expenses, purchases, and other transactions correctly.

* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and other financial accounts.

* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Track outstanding invoices, bills, and payments.

* Maintain organised financial records and supporting documentation.

* Assist with payroll records and related reconciliations where required.

* Keep accounting systems accurate, organised, and up to date.



### 2. Budgeting & Financial Planning



* Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets.

* Monitor actual spending against budget.

* Identify unnecessary expenses, overspending, and opportunities to reduce costs.

* Develop realistic financial forecasts based on historical performance and expected future activity.

* Help establish financial targets and monitor progress against them.

* Prepare different financial scenarios to support business planning and decision-making.

* Recommend practical ways to improve profitability and financial efficiency.



### 3. Financial Analysis & Reporting



* Prepare monthly profit and loss reports, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.

* Analyse revenue, expenses, gross profit, net profit, and profit margins.

* Compare financial performance across different months and periods.

* Identify unusual transactions, financial discrepancies, and emerging trends.

* Explain why financial performance has changed and highlight areas requiring attention.

* Provide clear summaries of the financial position of the business.

* Recommend actions based on the financial information available.



### 4. Cash Flow Management



* Prepare and maintain cash flow forecasts.

* Monitor money coming into and leaving the business.

* Forecast upcoming expenses, tax liabilities, and other financial commitments.

* Identify potential cash flow shortages before they occur.

* Help ensure sufficient funds are available to meet upcoming obligations.

* Monitor receivables and payables to support effective cash flow management.



### 5. Australian Tax & Compliance Support



* Understand Australian bookkeeping, GST, BAS, and general business tax requirements.

* Maintain accurate GST records and reconcile GST transactions.

* Assist with preparing information and supporting documentation for Business Activity Statements (BAS).

* Track relevant tax-related expenses and potential tax liabilities.

* Maintain organised records for Australian tax reporting and end-of-financial-year requirements.

* Assist with preparing financial information for the Australian accountant or registered tax agent.

* Monitor important reporting deadlines and help ensure financial records are ready on time.



**Important:** The role involves bookkeeping, tax preparation support, reconciliations, and coordination with Australian tax professionals. Any regulated tax agent services, tax advice, or lodgements requiring Australian registration must be handled by an appropriately registered professional.



### 6. Financial Systems & Process Improvement



* Maintain and improve bookkeeping spreadsheets and financial reporting systems.

* Use accounting software to streamline financial processes.

* Build and maintain Excel or Google Sheets dashboards.

* Automate repetitive financial tasks where practical.

* Improve the accuracy, consistency, and efficiency of financial reporting.

* Identify gaps in existing financial processes and recommend improvements.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE



Applicants should have:



* A degree in Accounting, Finance, Accountancy, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* At least 3 years of relevant experience in bookkeeping, accounting, financial analysis, or a similar position.

* Experience working with Australian businesses or a strong understanding of Australian accounting practices.

* Knowledge of Australian GST, BAS, and business tax requirements.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and financial reporting.

* Experience with accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, or QuickBooks.

* Experience preparing budgets, financial forecasts, and cash flow reports.

* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify errors or inconsistencies.

* Good written English and the ability to explain financial information clearly.

* The ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and take responsibility for deliverables.



Experience working remotely with Australian clients or businesses will be highly regarded.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who:



* Does not simply enter numbers but understands what those numbers mean.

* Can identify where money is being spent and explain whether that spending is reasonable.

* Can tell us how much money the business is making, where it is going, and what we should expect in the coming months.

* Can prepare a practical budget and monitor performance against it.

* Can identify financial risks and bring them to our attention early.

* Is proactive and suggests improvements instead of waiting to be told what to do.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.

* Is trustworthy and understands the importance of confidentiality.

* Produces accurate, professional, easy-to-understand financial reports.



We value practical ability, accuracy, initiative, and sound financial judgement just as much as formal qualifications.



## SOFTWARE & TOOLS



Experience with the following is preferred:



* Xero

* MYOB

* QuickBooks

* Microsoft Excel

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Office or Google Workspace



Experience building financial dashboards, management reports, and automated spreadsheets is an advantage.



## EXPECTED DELIVERABLES



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining a reliable financial reporting process, including:



* Accurate and up-to-date bookkeeping records.

* Regular bank and account reconciliations.

* Monthly profit and loss reports.

* Monthly budget-versus-actual reports.

* Cash flow forecasts covering the next 8–13 weeks.

* Monthly financial summaries highlighting key changes, risks, and opportunities.

* Tracking of upcoming bills, tax obligations, and other financial commitments.

* Organised financial documentation for Australian accountants and tax professionals.

* Recommendations for reducing costs, improving profitability, and strengthening financial management.



The exact reporting schedule and deliverables will be agreed upon during onboarding.



## CONFIDENTIALITY & TRUST



This position will involve access to sensitive financial and business information.



The successful candidate must demonstrate a high level of integrity, confidentiality, professionalism, and attention to detail.



A confidentiality agreement and appropriate access controls will be required. Access to financial systems and banking information will be granted according to the responsibilities of the role.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



1. Your CV or résumé.

2. A brief summary of your bookkeeping and financial analysis experience.

3. Details of your experience working with Australian businesses.

4. The accounting software you have used professionally.

5. An example of the types of budgets, financial reports, or cash flow forecasts you have prepared. Please remove any confidential client information.

6. Your expected monthly salary in PHP or AUD.

7. Your availability and preferred working hours.



**Application question:**



In your own words, explain how you would help a business owner understand their financial position, control expenses, forecast cash flow, and improve profitability.



We are looking for someone who can become a reliable, long-term member of our team and take ownership of the business's financial reporting and bookkeeping processes.

title: Part-Time Business Strategy & R&D Analyst
description:
# Part-Time Business Strategy & R&D Analyst



**Location:** Remote — Philippines

**Hours:** Part-Time (15–25 hours per week)

**Salary:** Negotiable based on experience



### About the Role



I'm looking for an exceptionally smart, commercially minded, and proactive individual to help me evaluate new business ideas and identify profitable opportunities.



This is NOT a standard market research or virtual assistant role.



I need someone who understands how businesses work, how they make money, how they acquire customers, and what makes a business succeed or fail.



When I present a new business idea, your job is to thoroughly investigate it, challenge my assumptions, identify potential problems, and determine whether it's worth investing my time and money into.



You must be an independent thinker who looks beyond the obvious, identifies opportunities others miss, and isn't afraid to tell me when an idea is bad.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Business Research & Feasibility**



* Evaluate business ideas and determine their commercial viability.

* Research competitors, market demand, pricing, revenue potential, and profitability.

* Identify market gaps, opportunities, risks, and competitive advantages.

* Estimate startup costs and determine whether the opportunity is worth pursuing.



**2. Marketing & Team Capability**



* Identify the top three marketing strategies for each business idea.

* Assess whether our existing marketer and developer, Shishir, have the skills to execute the strategy.

* Identify missing skills, resources, and potential outsourcing requirements.

* Recommend the most effective and cost-efficient ways to acquire customers.



**3. Australian Licensing & Regulations**



* Research the licences, registrations, permits, and legal requirements needed to launch a business in Australia.

* Identify relevant government authorities, costs, restrictions, and potential compliance risks.



**4. Business Strategy & Execution**



* Recommend the best pathway from idea to launch.

* Identify the biggest pitfalls and how to avoid them.

* Determine the cheapest and fastest way to validate demand before significant investment.

* Develop a practical action plan with clear priorities and milestones.

* Proactively identify new opportunities, strategic advantages, and better business models.



### Who I'm Looking For



* 3+ years of experience in business analysis, strategy, market research, consulting, business development, or entrepreneurship.

* Strong commercial intelligence and an understanding of how businesses operate.

* Excellent research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to evaluate business models, financial viability, competition, and marketing opportunities.

* Strong written English and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly.

* Experience researching the Australian market is a major advantage.

* Comfortable using AI research tools but capable of independently verifying information and forming original conclusions.



**Most importantly, I want someone who thinks independently, challenges assumptions, anticipates problems, and takes initiative without waiting for instructions.**



I value practical business judgement over academic qualifications.



### Expected Deliverable



For every business idea, I expect a concise, evidence-based report covering:



1. **Verdict:** Is this worth pursuing?

2. **Market:** Who are the customers, and who are the competitors?

3. **Profitability:** Can this realistically make money?

4. **Marketing:** What are the three best ways to acquire customers?

5. **Execution:** Can our existing team build and market it?

6. **Licensing:** What Australian licences and regulations apply?

7. **Risks:** What could go wrong?

8. **Strategy:** What competitive advantages can we develop?

9. **Action plan:** What should we do next, and in what order?



I want actionable recommendations backed by research, not generic reports filled with information I could find with a basic Google search.



### How to Apply



Please provide your CV, relevant experience, expected monthly salary, and examples of business research or commercial analysis you have completed.



Also answer this question:



**If I presented you with a completely new business idea tomorrow, how would you determine within the first 48 hours whether it was worth pursuing?**



I'm looking for someone who can become a trusted strategic partner in evaluating opportunities, avoiding costly mistakes, and helping me make better business decisions.

title: Full-Time Video Editor for E-Commerce Meta Ads | AI Skills Required | Long-Term | Answer ALL the Questions Below
description:
My name is Zebbi, and I'm the Head Editor at E-Factory Group SRL.



We're a team of 6 Italians running performance-driven e-commerce brands, mainly in the US and UK markets.



We're looking for a highly skilled, proactive, and performance-driven video editor to join our creative team for a full-time, long-term collaboration.



This is NOT a one-off project, and we're NOT simply expanding our team. We're looking for a strong editor to replace an existing team member.



We already have an established team of video editors, creative strategists, and a structured production workflow. We need someone who can come in, adapt quickly, and consistently deliver high-quality work.



We're not looking for someone who just knows how to put clips together.



We want an editor who THINKS.



Someone who understands what makes an ad sell, has a strong creative eye, knows when something doesn't look right, and is smart enough to go one step further instead of blindly following instructions.



WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:



- Has strong video editing skills and understands direct-response advertising.

- Already knows how to use AI image, video, and voice generation tools at a professional level.

- Can create high-quality, natural-looking AI content without constantly needing guidance.

- Thinks creatively and understands the difference between a video that looks good and a video that actually sells.

- Is proactive, resourceful, and capable of solving problems independently.

- Can follow a detailed brief while also suggesting improvements when something could be done better.

- Works efficiently without sacrificing quality.

- Communicates clearly, takes feedback seriously, and learns quickly.

- Is genuinely interested in improving their skills and staying ahead of new AI technologies.



AI experience is a REQUIREMENT, not a bonus.



We actively experiment with new AI tools, workflows, and creative formats. We share knowledge, help our editors improve, and keep the team updated on new developments.



However, we need someone who already understands the fundamentals. We can help you become better, but we can't spend weeks teaching you the basics.



HOW OUR WORKFLOW WORKS:



1. Our creative strategists develop the concepts, write the scripts, and prepare detailed creative briefs.

2. Your job is to turn those briefs into high-performing video ads.

This typically involves:

- Editing the main video body.

- Creating multiple hook variations (usually 5–10).

-  Generating voice-overs and AI avatars when needed.

- Creating AI-generated images and video clips.

- Finding relevant footage and references from social media or other platforms.

- Using and adapting footage from our internal library.

- Making each video feel engaging, natural, and native to social media.

- Improving creative execution wherever you see an opportunity.



You won't be responsible for developing the entire marketing strategy or writing scripts from scratch.



However, we expect you to think like a creative problem-solver, not just an executor.



If you notice a better way to communicate an idea, improve a visual, or make a scene more engaging, we want you to speak up.



PERFORMANCE FEEDBACK AND GROWTH:



We take performance seriously.

We track both editing performance and Meta Ads performance, including:



- Editing speed and production efficiency.

- Quality and consistency of deliverables.

- Number of revisions required.

- Ability to meet deadlines.

- Responsiveness to feedback.

- Performance of your creatives on Meta Ads.

- Reliability, initiative, and continuous improvement.



Our entire editing team is continuously evaluated, not to micromanage people, but to identify weaknesses, improve our processes, and help everyone become more effective.



We also have a weekly team meeting of approximately 1 hour, where we discuss what's working, what needs improvement, new creative approaches, and opportunities to grow.



Attendance is required. We want people who actively participate, contribute ideas, and care about the team's results.



COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE BONUS:



We believe strongly in meritocracy.



In addition to your regular base pay, we offer:



$50 BONUS for every winning ad creative you produce.



We reward results, not just hours worked.



We also believe great performance should lead to better compensation.



If you're consistently delivering excellent work, improving your efficiency, and contributing to the company's results, you won't have to chase us for a raise. We'll be the first to propose one.



We want editors who are motivated to grow, and we're willing to reward those who prove their value.



AVAILABILITY AND LONG TERM COMMITMENT:



This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday (8 hours per day) + some hours in the weekend but only if you want.



We're looking for someone who can consistently dedicate that time to our team and treat this as a serious professional commitment.



We're not interested in short-term collaborations or editors who are constantly juggling too many projects.



Our goal is to build a long-term working relationship, provided it's a good fit for both sides.



If you perform well, you'll have the opportunity to grow with the company, improve your skills, take on more responsibility, and increase your earnings over time.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please answer all the questions below as part of your application.



Our selection process includes a portfolio review, a short introductory video call, and a practical editing trial.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS:



1. How old are you?



2. What is your nationality, country of residence and time zone?



3. How many years of professional video editing experience do you have?



4. Which AI-related tasks are you genuinely confident performing at a professional level?



IMPORTANT: By "confident," we mean you can consistently deliver excellent results with little to no revisions required most of the time.



Please write ONLY the tasks you are genuinely skilled at. We are not interested in a long list of tools or skills you have barely experimented with. Be honest about your actual capabilities.



5. Which video ad formats are you genuinely confident creating at a professional level?



The same rule applies: only write formats you can consistently execute at a high standard with minimal revisions.



6. Please share links to your 3-5 BEST video ads.



We want to see your absolute best work, not necessarily your most recent projects. Please only share ads you personally edited.



- Best Ad #1:

- Best Ad #2:

- Best Ad #3:

- Best Ad #4 (optional):

- Best Ad #5 (optional):



7. Please share a link to your portfolio.



8. Please carefully watch the following video: 



How many working hours would you realistically need to create and deliver a video of similar quality and editing complexity?



We'll provide a detailed brief with the script, but you are responsible for editing, sourcing footage, generating AI assets when needed, and delivering the finished video.



Please provide an estimate in working hours, not calendar days.



9. Are you willing to complete a short editing trial as part of our selection process?



The trial will involve editing a video approximately 2 minutes long, including 3 different hook variations.



10. How many hours per week can you consistently dedicate to our team?



11. Are you available for a short introductory video call (approximately 15–20 minutes) as part of our selection process?



We'd like to briefly get to know you, discuss your experience, and see if we're a good fit for each other.



Thanks,

Zebbi

Head Editor

E-Factory Group SRL

title: Youtube Thumbnail Designer
description:
You study what works on YouTube and adapt winning concepts from other niches (e.g. a golf thumbnail based on a tennis one).



I value a clear, well-thought-out thumbnail concept: it should be understood in a split second. I don't want an overloaded, typical AI-looking thumbnail.





THE WORK:

- 30 thumbnails per week.

- For each video you'll receive the title. Then you d
 the concept, and you create the thumbnail.

- Before every thumbnail, you must research proven formats on YouTube and show your references. Typing the title into ChatGPT and picking an output doesn’t count.





REQUIRED:

1. Strong creative instinct: you can find the visual hook of a title without being told what it should look like.

2. Strong Photoshop skills. You must be able to retouch, composite and fix AI images.

3. You are expected to use AI tools, but raw AI output is not acceptable. If you use AI, I expect heavy editing and modification on top of it.

4. Fast responses and reliable delivery.



💰 $150 a month, part time. Rising to $200 after 6 months and to $300 after 1 year.





TO APPLY CREATE ONE DOCUMENT WITH:

A. Choose 2 of these 4 titles and create one test thumbnail for each:



- What Happened When Jewish Families Tried to Reclaim Their Companies?

- What Happened to Every Villa the SS Used as Headquarters?

- This Chinese Family Quietly Owns Britain's Water, Power and Ports

- One Chinese Family Ruled This Village, and Made Every Resident a Millionaire



B. Write 2 sentences per thumbnail explaining your concept and why it makes viewers click.



C. Attach 3 screenshots of existing YouTube thumbnails that show your research: concepts from videos that already perform well, and that inspired your thumbnails. Before designing, I want to see that you check what works on YouTube. READ "HOW TO RESEACH".



NOTE:

Test thumbnails will not be used on any of our videos.





HOW TO RESEARCH. EXAMPLES:



Search for the format, not the topic.

- Never type our title into YouTube and copy what comes up.

- We are not going to copy another video.

- Search with simple phrases, the way a curious viewer would, not with the exact title of an existing video.

- Look for videos from other niches that share the same idea or trigger, then adapt the concept to our title.

- Don't send references from the same topic, or from videos with few views. Your thumbnail has to be based on thumbnails that got a lot of views. Pasting the title into ChatGPT and keeping the result usually gives a composition that makes no sense.



Example 1: "The Best Tennis Players in History"

- Search: "best football players of all time", "greatest chess players", "deadliest serial killers", "greatest boxers ever".

- If the winning thumbnails use four panels with one person in each, we can do the same with four tennis players.

- If they show the best player on one side and a curious object on the other, we can do something similar with a top player and something iconic of tennis.



Example 2: "The Two Secret Rooms Behind China's Military Power"

- The idea: a secret place that makes people curious about what's inside.

- Search: "secret bunker", "secret military base", "underground city", "hidden tunnels".

- If a winning thumbnail shows one mysterious building isolated in the middle of a forest, we can do a similar concept with our secret rooms.



Example 3: "The Government Inside India That Has Never Once Been Elected"

- The trigger: mysterious hidden power. People we don't know make the real decisions.

- Search: "who controls Britain", "who really controls America", "who runs the Federal Reserve", "secret rulers of the world".

- If the winning thumbnails show shadowy figures around a table with their faces hidden, we can do a similar concept, so the viewer feels the power but can't tell who they are.



Example 4: "How Secret Societies Really Recruit, Rank and Rule"

- The idea: explaining a whole system, step by step.

- Search: "Roman army ranks", "how the mafia works", "how cartels are organized", "Catholic Church hierarchy".

- If the winning thumbnails show a ladder of ranks, or panels where each one shows a different situation, we can do a similar concept, with each step looking clearly different from the last.

title: Packaging Designer (E-commerce / Consumer Products)
description:
To Apply, please share your resume, portfolio, and answers to the questions below. Please follow the application instructions carefully and ensure that all requested materials and answers are included in your submission. Incomplete applications may not be considered.



About the Role



We are looking for a skilled Packaging Designer to create clean, functional, and premium packaging for kitchen and consumer products sold online.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience designing packaging for physical products, understands print production requirements, and can turn brand concepts into practical, production-ready designs.

You'll be responsible for creating packaging that looks professional, protects the product, communicates its value, and works well across e-commerce platforms such as Amazon.



This role requires a balance of creativity, technical accuracy, and practical thinking. You'll work with product, operations, marketing, and manufacturing teams to ensure that packaging designs meet brand standards, production requirements, and cost considerations.



Key Responsibilities

- Design packaging for physical products, including boxes, inserts, labels, and product manuals.

- Create print-ready packaging files based on manufacturer specifications and dieline requirements.

- Ensure packaging designs balance visual appeal, product protection, readability, durability, and cost efficiency.

- Develop packaging optimized for e-commerce platforms, particularly Amazon, using clear layouts, icons, product callouts, and appropriate compliance elements.

- Collaborate with operations teams and suppliers to refine designs based on manufacturing constraints and production requirements.

- Maintain consistent branding across multiple products and SKUs.

- Improve existing packaging designs and support packaging refreshes, new product launches, and product line extensions.

- Review packaging files carefully to ensure accuracy and readiness for production.



Qualifications and Requirements

- At least 3 years of experience in packaging design, preferably for consumer products or e-commerce brands.

- Proven experience designing packaging for physical products, not just digital graphics or marketing materials.

- Strong understanding of box structures, dielines, and print production processes.

- Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator is required.

- Familiarity with CMYK color modes, bleed settings, print specifications, and production-ready artwork.

- Ability to create clean, professional, and functional designs without unnecessary decorative elements.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage design deliverables independently.

- Comfortable revising designs based on feedback from marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams.



Nice to Have

- Experience designing packaging for kitchenware, home goods, or other consumer products.

- Previous experience working with Amazon sellers or direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and/or InDesign.

- Understanding of cost-conscious packaging decisions, including material selection, ink limitations, and packaging dimensions.

- Experience adapting packaging designs for different marketplaces or regions.



Work Setup

- Location: Remote

- Employment Type: Full-time

- Engagement: Long-term opportunity for the right candidate





To Apply, please share your resume, portfolio, and answers to the questions below. Please follow the application instructions carefully and ensure that all requested materials and answers are included in your submission. Incomplete applications may not be considered.

1. Describe one packaging project you worked on for a physical product. What was the product, and what was your role in the design process?

2. When working with dielines and print files, what are the key things you check before sending a design to production?

3. How do you approach designing packaging that is both visually appealing and functional (e.g., protects the product, communicates clearly, and meets production requirements)?

4. Have you ever had to revise a packaging design due to manufacturing or cost constraints? What changes did you make and why?

5. What tools and software do you use for packaging design, and how do you typically prepare files for print (e.g., color mode, bleed, file setup)?

It runs embedded inside partner web portals and as a standalone web app. You will be the quality owner on a small senior team (four full-stack engineers and you), from the first week to launch.

title: Senior Business Funding Specialist – Business Credit Cards, Funding Strategy & Credit Optimization
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Business Funding Specialist** with in-depth knowledge of business credit cards, unsecured business funding, bank underwriting criteria, credit profile optimization, and funding application sequencing.



The ideal candidate understands how banks evaluate business owners for credit approvals and higher credit limits. You must be able to analyze personal and business credit profiles, identify weaknesses that could affect approval odds, and develop a strategic funding plan based on the applicant’s financial profile and lender requirements.



We are looking for a strategic thinker who understands the entire funding process — from credit preparation and lender research to application sequencing, approval tracking, and ongoing credit management.



**This is not an entry-level data-entry position. We need someone with real-world business funding experience who can explain the reasoning behind their recommendations.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Business Credit Card Applications & Funding Strategy



- Develop strategic funding plans for entrepreneurs and business owners seeking business credit cards and unsecured business funding.

- Research banks and financial institutions offering business credit cards, business lines of credit, and other legitimate funding products.

- Understand lender-specific underwriting criteria, including credit score requirements, credit history, utilization, inquiries, existing debt, income, and business financials.

- Determine which lenders may be an appropriate fit for a client's profile.

- Develop funding application sequences based on lender criteria, application rules, eligibility, and the client's overall funding objectives.

- Understand application timing, inquiry sensitivity, velocity restrictions, and potential impacts on approval odds.

- Track application results, approval amounts, credit limits, denials, and reconsideration opportunities.

- Help identify potential paths toward maximizing legitimate funding opportunities while minimizing unnecessary hard inquiries.



### 2. Credit Profile Analysis & Optimization



- Review personal credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- Analyze credit scores, revolving utilization, payment history, derogatory accounts, inquiries, account age, and credit mix.

- Understand how personal credit profiles may affect business credit card approvals and personal guarantees.

- Identify issues that may need to be addressed before submitting funding applications.

- Develop credit optimization strategies based on each client's individual circumstances.

- Understand the relationship between personal credit, business credit, and lender approval decisions.

- Recommend appropriate steps to improve creditworthiness before funding applications.



### 3. Credit Repair Knowledge & Credit Management



- Understand credit reporting, the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), and the legitimate dispute process.

- Identify potentially inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unverifiable credit report information that may warrant investigation or dispute.

- Understand credit utilization management, payment history, account management, and responsible revolving credit usage.

- Help develop action plans for addressing legitimate credit reporting issues.

Please begin your application with the phrase “FUNDING STRATEGIST” so we know you have read the entire job post.

- Understand how to manage existing credit accounts and maintain a strong credit profile before and after funding.

- Recognize when a client should prioritize credit improvement rather than immediately applying for additional credit.



### 4. Business Credit & Financial Profile Evaluation



- Understand business credit fundamentals and the differences between personal and business credit.

- Evaluate business age, entity information, revenue, cash flow, existing business obligations, and other factors relevant to lender eligibility.

- Understand how banks may evaluate sole proprietors, LLCs, and corporations.

- Research business credit reporting agencies and business credit-building strategies.

- Understand the role of EINs, personal guarantees, business bank accounts, and financial documentation in funding applications.

- Identify legitimate funding options appropriate for different business profiles.



### 5. Funding Research, Documentation & Reporting



- Maintain an updated database of bank underwriting guidelines, application requirements, and funding products.

- Track lender policies, application restrictions, and changes to approval requirements.

- Prepare client-specific funding roadmaps and application checklists.

- Maintain organized records of applications, approvals, denials, credit limits, and follow-up actions.

- Create standard operating procedures (SOPs) for funding preparation, application sequencing, and client onboarding.

- Provide weekly reports on application performance, approval rates, and total approved funding.



## Required Qualifications



- Proven experience in business credit card applications and business funding strategy.

- Strong understanding of bank underwriting criteria and lender approval requirements.

- Demonstrated knowledge of business credit cards, unsecured business funding, and business lines of credit.

- Practical experience developing funding application sequences.

- Strong understanding of personal credit reports, FICO scoring factors, utilization, inquiries, and credit profile optimization.

- Working knowledge of credit repair, credit reporting, and applicable consumer protection laws.

- Ability to research lender requirements and distinguish verified policies from speculation.

- Excellent analytical, organizational, and written communication skills.

- Ability to explain funding recommendations and the reasoning behind them.

- Proficiency with Google Sheets, spreadsheets, CRM systems, and online research tools.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with U.S. banks and financial institutions.

- Experience helping U.S. entrepreneurs obtain business credit cards or unsecured business funding.

- Familiarity with major U.S. credit card issuers and their business application requirements.

- Experience creating funding roadmaps, lender comparison sheets, and application tracking systems.

- Familiarity with FICO scoring models, business credit bureaus, and credit monitoring platforms.

- Experience in a credit repair, business funding, lending, or financial consulting company.



## Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will be evaluated on:



- Quality and accuracy of credit profile analyses.

- Quality of lender research and funding recommendations.

- Accuracy and usefulness of application sequencing plans.

- Organization and completeness of client funding files.

- Timeliness of application tracking and reporting.

- Ability to identify and communicate potential approval obstacles.

- Compliance with applicable laws, lender terms, and client authorization requirements.



**Important:** We value sound underwriting analysis and responsible funding strategies over simply submitting as many applications as possible. Approval amounts and outcomes are never guaranteed.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A summary of your experience in business credit cards and business funding.

2. The U.S. banks and financial institutions you have experience researching or working with.

3. Your experience analyzing personal credit profiles and business credit eligibility.

4. An explanation of how you approach funding application sequencing and lender selection.

5. An example of a funding roadmap or lender comparison sheet you have created, with all client-identifying and confidential information removed.

6. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

7. Your availability and preferred working hours.







We are looking for someone who brings expertise, strategic thinking, attention to detail, and a genuine understanding of how business funding works.
