title: Meta ads video editor
description:
We're hiring a freelance short-form video editor to cut our paid social ads, paid per concept batch, with a clear path to a full-time role.



The role



Giants is a UK direct-to-consumer brand making collagen protein coffee: Salted Caramel and Smooth Vanilla lattes you make in seconds with water, each scoop carrying 10g of collagen protein. Our customers are busy UK women who want a daily latte that happens to be good for them, not another supplement chore.



Almost all of our growth comes from Meta and TikTok video ads. Most of those are creator (UGC) videos filmed on a phone in a real kitchen. We need an editor who can take raw creator footage and turn it into ads that feel like a friend's post, not an advert.



Type



Freelance, paid per concept batch



Location

Remote; UK time zone overlap needed for feedback



Volume to start



5-6 concept batches a week



Future



Full-time in-house editor role for the right person



Reports to



Growth / creative lead



What you'll edit



One concept batch is one idea turned into a family of tested ads. You get the brief, the raw footage and the script; we get back:



Deliverable



Detail



Master edit



30 to 75s, 9:16 at 1080x1920, captions burned in



Hook variants



3 to 5 versions that swap only the first 2 to 4 seconds onto the same body



Project files



Organised and named so anyone can pick them up



The formats you'll cut most:



• Organic ads / mini vsls: mini vsls that don't seem like ads with organic style footage

• POV latte demos: scoop, water, stir, froth, sip, cut on the action

• Founder videos: talking to camera

• Multi-creator stitches: several creators cut together around one idea



You'll also recut our existing winning ads into new hook and length variants.



How we edit



Our one rule: if it looks like an ad, it's wrong. Our best performers look like something a friend posted from her kitchen.



• Frame one moves. Something is already happening: a pour, a fumble, a hand on the pouch. No "hi guys" openers.



• The hook lands three ways at once. What she says, what's on screen and one line of text all hit in the first 3 seconds.



• Tight jump cuts. Breaths, pauses and restarts come out, roughly every 1.5 to 4 seconds. Real fumbles, laughs and coughs stay in.



• The latte is the money shot. Foam, steam, the pour and the stir get room to breathe, and it looks creamy before any benefit is said.



• Native text only. One lowercase line at a time, in the app's own text style, kept clear of the platform buttons. No designed graphics, brand fonts or logo end cards.



• Real sound, no music bed. Kettle, spoon and kitchen noise stay in. None of our winning ads use music.



• No polish. No grading, LUTs, zoom transitions, whooshes or glitch effects.



• UK ad rules. No medication names, no weight-loss claims, no cure or guarantee language. We'll give you the full list, and you'll flag anything in a creator's footage that breaks it.



Who we're looking for



Must-haves:



• At least 1 year editing short-form paid social ads (Meta, TikTok or Reels), with UGC or creator footage in your portfolio

• Fast, confident jump-cut editing of talking-head footage

• Strong instinct for hooks and the first 3 seconds

• Comfortable in Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut or DaVinci Resolve

• Reliable on turnaround and quick to act on short, direct feedback

• Fluent English with an ear for British speech, slang and humour



Nice-to-haves:

• Edited for DTC brands in food, drink, beauty or wellness

• Knows how to read ad metrics like hook rate, hold rate and CTR, and edits towards them

• Experience with AI voiceover (for example ElevenLabs) or AI captioning tools

• Knowledge of UK advertising rules (ASA) for health and food claims

• Based in or familiar with the UK market



How it works

1. Paid test batch. Shortlisted editors cut one real concept batch for us, paid at your quoted rate.

2. Brief. Each batch comes with raw footage in a shared folder, a script or edit plan, hook ideas and references from ads that are working.

3. First cut in 48 to 72 hours. Delivered as a review link plus final files.

4. Up to 2 rounds of revisions per batch, included in the rate.

5. We test and share results. You'll see which hooks and cuts won, so every batch gets sharper.



Pay: a fixed rate per concept batch, agreed upfront and paid on delivery. Tell us your rate per batch in your application.



Path to full time: after around 3 months of consistent batches, we'll review volume and results together. If it's working on both sides, we'll offer a full-time in-house editor role with a fixed salary and ownership of our video output.



How to apply



Send your portfolio to 
 with the subject line "Giants video editor – [your name]". Please include:

1. 3 to 5 short-form ads you edited, ideally UGC or creator-led, as links (Drive, 
, TikTok or Instagram). Tell us what you did on each: full edit, captions only, or hooks.

2. Your best hook. Point us to the first 3 seconds you're proudest of and say why it works.

3. Results, if you have them: hook rate, CTR, spend or anything else the brand shared with you.

4. Your rate per concept batch, using the deliverables listed above.

title: GoHighLevel Systems Architect
description:
About Plain Simple CRM

Plain Simple CRM builds CRM systems and marketing ecosystems for real estate professionals. Our goal is simple: technology should get out of the agent’s way so they can sell more houses.

We are looking for a highly organized GoHighLevel Systems Architect & Marketing Operations Lead to own the structure, quality, scalability, and continuous improvement of our GHL operating environment.

This is not a basic GHL implementation role. We need someone who can design the blueprint, organize the backend, connect systems to marketing outcomes, document the process, and train others to execute it consistently.

The Role

You will work alongside our existing technical implementation team. The implementation team will continue executing approved builds. You will own the architecture, standards, QA, documentation, training, and platform intelligence that make those builds consistent and scalable.

You will be the organizational brain behind our GHL infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

GHL Architecture and Schema Governance

● Maintain clean schemas, pipelines, stages, tags, custom fields, folders, permissions, and naming conventions.

● Manage backend Schema IDs while maintaining clear, user-friendly GHL display names.

● Organize modular products such as [CORE] Launchpad and [ADD-ON] Social Media.

● Maintain reusable snapshots, templates, and system standards.

● Eliminate tag bloat, duplicate workflows, conflicting automations, and unnecessary complexity.

Workflow and Marketing Logic

● Audit and map lead routing, pipeline movement, nurture sequences, notifications, calendars, and automations.

● Ensure workflows make sense from both a technical and marketing perspective.

● Connect lead generation, newsletters, paid and organic social, speed-to-lead, sales follow-up, reporting, and retention.

● Ensure messaging and sequences match the lead’s stage and intent.

Quality Assurance

● Act as the final quality gate before systems or products launch.

● Test forms, links, triggers, workflows, pipelines, calendars, integrations, notifications, and reporting.

● Maintain implementation, testing, and launch checklists.

● Identify risks before they become client-facing problems.

Documentation and Training

● Create SOPs, process maps, onboarding checklists, and internal system documentation.

● Build client and team training inside the GHL Community LMS.

● Translate complex systems into simple, step-by-step instructions.

● Train team members on approved processes and standards.

● Build systems clearly enough that a competent person can follow the documentation and reproduce the result.

GHL Platform Intelligence

● Stay current on official GHL releases, feature updates, AI developments, API changes, integrations, deliverability requirements, webinars,
 groups, and community discussions.

● Test important updates before using them in client accounts.

● Maintain a GHL change log showing what changed, what is affected, and what action is required.

● Provide a weekly update covering what changed, what matters, and what we should do next.

● Turn relevant discoveries into SOPs, training, templates, or product improvements.

Compliance Awareness

● Maintain awareness of A2P 10DLC, SMS consent, opt-out, deliverability, and related messaging requirements.

● Ensure forms, workflows, and campaigns are designed with compliance and deliverability in mind.

Required Qualifications

● Advanced GoHighLevel experience.

● Strong marketing or marketing operations background.

● Experience with CRM architecture, workflows, pipelines, custom fields, tags, snapshots, and integrations.

● Exceptional attention to detail.

● Strong documentation, communication, and project management skills.

● Ability to explain technical systems simply.

● Ability to audit existing work and improve it professionally.

● Demonstrated habit of following GHL developments and applying relevant updates.

Preferred Qualifications

● Experience with real estate agents, teams, transactions, and deadlines.

● Knowledge of lead generation,
 and SMS marketing, websites, Google Business Profiles, SEO, and reporting.

● Experience building systems for agencies or multiple client accounts.

First 90-Day Outcomes

● Audit current GHL accounts, workflows, schemas, tags, pipelines, and snapshots.

● Establish architecture and naming standards.

● Create system inventory, change log, QA checklist, and implementation checklist.

● Document high-priority recurring processes.

● Build initial team and client training modules.

● Reduce rework, errors, duplicate assets, and founder involvement.

● Identify at least three improvements to delivery speed, usability, or marketing performance.

If you cringe when you see 400 unorganized tags and randomly named workflows, you may be the right person for this role.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/TypeScript/React) - Remote

- Build embeddable experiences for partner portals: iframe integration, web components with style isolation, and signed-token (JWT) single sign-on.

- Implement authentication, role-based access, subscription billing through a payment processor's hosted pages, and server-side plan entitlements.

- Work on AWS: containers, managed PostgreSQL, CDN, scheduled workflows and infrastructure as code.

- Write automated tests alongside your code and keep the CI pipeline green.

- Take part in sprint demos, code reviews and technical decisions with the team.



OUR STACK

- Backend: Node.js 24, TypeScript (strict), Fastify, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL 16, Zod

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Router and Query, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui

- Cloud: AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, WAF, KMS, Step Functions, EventBridge), AWS CDK

- Auth: Clerk, JWT / JWKS

- Testing and delivery: Vitest, Playwright, Testcontainers, GitHub Actions, Docker



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 8+ years of professional software engineering, with strong experience across both backend and frontend.

- Strong TypeScript in production on Node.js and React.

- Solid PostgreSQL skills: schema design, indexing, transactions and query performance.

- Experience integrating third-party REST APIs with OAuth 2.0 and webhooks.

- Experience shipping on AWS, or a comparable cloud, with containers and CI/CD.

- Care for correctness, security and clean, maintainable code (DRY, SOLID, small focused modules).

- Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working directly with a client's product owner.

- Experienced AI Enabled Engineer that uses proper harnesses, agents and skills and Daily use of AI-assisted engineering tools (for example Claude Code), with the judgement to review and test their output. This is a must!!!



WE PREFER PEOPLE WITH

- Fintech experience: open banking, accounting (e.g., QuickBooks Online), payments or subscription billing.

- Building embeddable widgets or SDKs (web components, Shadow DOM, iframe + postMessage).

- Security practices for financial data: encryption, row-level security, OWASP ASVS.

- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and frontend performance.



JOIN US!

- Work with a passionate, collaborative team that values ownership and innovation

- Opportunity to shape the future of our tech stack and product direction

title: SENIOR SEO SPECIALIST -  Claude Code Knowledge is a Must!
description:
# SEO Specialist



### About the Role



We are a performance-driven digital marketing agency serving home service and local businesses across Canada and the United States.



We are looking for a **hands-on SEO Specialist** to manage SEO execution across multiple client accounts and drive measurable business results.



### Key Responsibilities



- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and SEO audits.

- Optimize website content, metadata, internal linking, and schema.

- Identify and resolve technical SEO issues.

- Develop content strategies, topic clusters, and SEO briefs.

- Optimize Google Business Profiles and local landing pages.

- Identify backlink and link-building opportunities.

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and leads.

- Prepare monthly performance reports and recommendations.

- Proactively identify opportunities for client growth.



### Requirements



- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience.

- Strong knowledge of technical, on-page, content, and local SEO.

- Experience with WordPress, Rank Math, Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, and Screaming Frog.

- Ability to manage multiple client websites independently.

- Strong written English and attention to detail.

- Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity.

- Strong problem-solving and communication skills.



**Preferred:** Agency experience and SEO experience with roofing, HVAC, plumbing, construction, or other home-service businesses.



### What Success Looks Like



We focus on results, not just completed tasks.



Success means increasing qualified organic traffic, generating leads, improving search visibility, and consistently identifying growth opportunities.



### Who We're Looking For



Someone who takes ownership, thinks critically, and proactively solves problems.



If rankings decline, you investigate. If competitors outperform us, you find out why. If you identify an opportunity, you take action.



**We value initiative, accountability, and measurable results.**

title: US Recruiter (Executive Search - Non Profit)
description:
## About the Opportunity



We're looking for an experienced **US Executive Recruiter** to join an established US-based executive search firm specializing in leadership recruitment across **nonprofit, education, and healthcare organizations**.



This is a relationship-driven recruitment role. You'll be identifying and engaging senior professionals, including candidates who aren't actively looking for new opportunities, and helping organizations find the right leaders.



We're open to recruiters from different experience levels, provided you have a solid US recruitment background, strong outbound sourcing skills, and the ability to take ownership of your work.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Identify, source, and engage senior management and executive-level candidates across the US.

- Conduct proactive outreach through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and outbound calls.

- Build relationships with passive candidates and assess their suitability for leadership opportunities.

- Manage multiple searches, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and follow-ups.

- Maintain accurate candidate pipelines and communicate progress with internal stakeholders.

- Work independently, proactively resolve challenges, and follow through on commitments.



## What We're Looking For



**Must-haves:**

- Proven experience recruiting for the US market.

- Hands-on outbound sourcing, headhunting, and candidate engagement experience.

- Exposure to senior management, Director, VP, or executive-level recruitment.

- Strong spoken English and confidence conducting calls and video interviews.

- Warm, personable, and professional communication style.

- Ability to manage multiple searches and work independently.



**Ideal but not required:**

- Recruitment experience within nonprofit, education, or healthcare organizations.

- Experience conducting executive searches or engaging passive senior-level talent.

- Experience managing recruitment teams or working directly with senior hiring stakeholders.



## Compensation & Work Setup



- Compensation: Around USD $1,600/month (+/-), depending on relevant experience and demonstrated capabilities.

- Location:100% remote, Philippines-based.

- Schedule: Full-time, PST schedule



To APPLY - answer the following questions here:



1. **US recruitment:** How many years have you recruited for the US market? What industries and types of positions have you primarily handled?



2. **Seniority of searches:** What's the highest-level position you've personally recruited for and successfully filled? Have you handled Director, VP, or C-level searches?



3. **Sourcing and outreach:** How do you typically find and engage candidates, particularly those who aren't actively job hunting? Do you regularly conduct outbound calls?



4. **Ownership:** Do you manage searches end-to-end, from sourcing through placement, or are you primarily responsible for certain stages? How many searches do you typically handle at once?



5. **Industry exposure:** Have you recruited for nonprofit, education, or healthcare organizations? If yes, what types of positions?



6. **Work arrangement:** Are you comfortable working full-time US Pacific hours, exclusively, with no concurrent employment? What is your target range?

title: Bookkeeping & Operations VA (Trades/Construction)
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, hands-on Xero experience and a background in Australian trades or construction admin will be prioritised for this role.



A fast-growing Australian trades business needs a part-time VA — initially 20 hours per week across Monday to Friday afternoons — to take ownership of the admin and bookkeeping workload that has accumulated alongside rapid growth. This is a hands-on, operationally-focused role with a strong bookkeeping component. The right person will be confident in Xero and Australian bookkeeping fundamentals, with enough initiative to work autonomously during a business day when the owner is largely unreachable on-site.



The challenge being solved is straightforward: the business owner is doing the financial and administrative work himself because there is currently no one else to do it, and it’s costing him the time and headspace he needs to operate and grow the business. There is enough work to justify a full-time hire within the foreseeable future; the part-time start is about setting the right person up well before expanding their hours.



Success at 90 days looks like daily reconciliation and invoicing running without the owner’s involvement, job-level cost tracking maintained consistently, outstanding invoices being chased, and payroll preparation happening on schedule — an inbox with a clean summary waiting, not a list of tasks still to do.



What You’ll Own



Bookkeeping & Financial Management



Reconcile Xero weekly and flag any unmatched transactions for review

Process and manage invoices: review, allocate, and confirm against jobs in the job management platform

Track and document approved variations to ensure all chargeable work is captured before a job closes

Follow up outstanding invoices as directed

Assist with payroll data preparation for review and submission

Support BAS and IAS data preparation each quarter, flagging key dates in advance

Process supplier payments as directed via an international payments platform

Keep on top of outstanding bills and flag upcoming payment deadlines



Invoicing & Variation Tracking



Review completed jobs weekly and identify any un-invoiced or under-invoiced variations

Cross-check field reports against the scope of work and flag anything not yet charged

Prepare and send invoices, ensuring ABN, address, quantities, and scope details are correct



Job-Level Cost Tracking & Reporting



Maintain job-level spreadsheets tracking cost versus income for each active job

Pull weekly data from job management platforms to update job profitability trackers

Identify jobs where costs are high relative to expected margins and flag for review

Compile a weekly job summary covering what has been invoiced, what’s in progress, and what’s outstanding

Track supplier invoices against jobs and ensure costs are allocated correctly



Inbox & Communication Management



Filter and manage the business inbox daily — categorise, action, forward invoices to Xero as required

Ensure no client follow-up messages or leads go unanswered; flag anything requiring direct attention

Handle routine supplier communication: order confirmations, delivery queries

Send job confirmation, scheduling, and follow-up messages to clients as directed



Scheduling & Task Management



Assist with managing the job calendar and scheduling as directed

Coordinate subcontractor and team scheduling when instructed

Set reminders for recurring tasks: invoicing runs, payroll deadlines, vehicle registrations, licence renewals, and subscriptions

Maintain a running list of ideas and pending tasks so nothing falls through the cracks



SOP Documentation & Systems



Document processes as they’re learned, in real time rather than retrospectively

Maintain and update task records in Asana with daily, weekly, and monthly cadences

Contribute to the business handbook as the role develops



Daily Communication



Send a morning WhatsApp message with top priorities for the day

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and anything requiring attention or approval



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Experience in general admin and bookkeeping support in an Australian business context

Familiar with Australian bookkeeping basics: GST, invoicing, reconciliation, payroll, BAS/IAS

Prior experience with trades or construction businesses is a strong advantage

Experience with job management software is a plus; fast learning of equivalent platforms is essential

Comfortable working in a small, fast-growing business without fully formalised systems



Technical Proficiency



Xero: required, with strong practical proficiency

Experience with trade-specific job management platforms is a plus; training provided

Confident with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Drive)

Able to build and maintain job-level cost tracking spreadsheets in Excel or Google Sheets

Comfortable with WhatsApp, including voice notes, as the primary comms channel

Basic proficiency in Asana, or willing to learn



Organisational Skills



High attention to detail, particularly reviewing invoices, variations, and job costs

Able to manage a high-volume inbox and triage effectively without daily direction

Capable of maintaining multiple active job trackers simultaneously without losing accuracy

Proactive about setting reminders and following up on time-sensitive items



Communication Skills



Strong written and verbal English — will handle client and supplier communication directly

Brief, clear and to the point; phone calls are preferred for urgent matters, with voice notes and short WhatsApp messages for day-to-day

Comfortable batching questions into a single call rather than interrupting multiple times

Confident enough to follow up on outstanding information rather than waiting



Non-Negotiables



Works autonomously for extended periods without daily check-ins

Initiates tasks without needing to be prompted; doesn’t wait for direction on repeatable processes

Treats the numbers as business-critical, not just admin — understands that missed variations, untracked costs, and late invoices have real dollar consequences

Raises flags early when something doesn’t look right

Naturally documents what they learn and builds processes that don’t rely on memory

Comfortable with ambiguity in a business that’s still building out its systems

Treats confidentiality as standard practice, given access to financial and client data



Working Arrangements



Part-time to start, 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday afternoons (exact hours TBC at placement)

Genuine path to full-time once settled in and capability is proven

Primary point of contact is largely unreachable on-site during the day; a second-in-charge is available by phone in their absence



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of the financial and operational backbone of a growing business

A clear, stated path to full-time hours as the role proves out

Real autonomy and trust from day one, working directly with the business owner

Exposure to the setup of a new business function, with future scope to grow into lead generation and CRM work as the business expands



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction. It helps us shortlist quickly:

title: Inventory & Accounts Coordinator (Cin7 Core / QBO)
description:
About the Role



We are a CPG food & beverage brand looking for a detail-oriented and highly organised Inventory & Accounts Coordinator to support the business across Cin7 Core, inventory management, purchasing, invoicing, bookkeeping, and monthly financial reconciliation.



This role sits between operations and finance — ensuring that product, inventory, customer, supplier, and accounting records remain accurate and up to date across both Cin7 Core and QuickBooks Online. The ideal candidate is highly comfortable with numbers, systems, and recurring financial processes, with the ability to work independently and spot discrepancies before they become larger issues.



Work Structure & Requirements



Schedule: Part-time

Location: Remote

Timezone: EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



Inventory & Cin7 Core Management

Maintain accurate product, supplier, and customer data in Cin7 Core

Manage inventory levels and maintain accurate stock visibility

Input finished product builds / recipes to support MRP and inventory planning

Map ingredient item numbers to supplier item numbers and finished goods to customer item numbers

Input and maintain customer and supplier records

Monitor inventory transactions and investigate discrepancies

Help reconcile Cin7 Core inventory records against supporting operational data

Purchasing, Invoicing & Revenue

Create and send purchase orders through Cin7 Core

Maintain accurate PO records and supporting documentation

Invoice direct customers and distributors

Manage customer-specific pricing and ensure invoices reflect agreed terms

Track revenue across Amazon, DTC, distributors, and direct customers

Reconcile sales activity across channels

Support distributor deductions and customer account adjustments as required

Bookkeeping & Accounts Support

Maintain accurate bookkeeping records in QuickBooks Online

Support accounts receivable and accounts payable administration

Record and categorise expenses accurately

Reconcile bank, credit card, and other balance sheet accounts

Match invoices, payments, and expenses to supporting documentation

Track outstanding customer balances and supplier payments

Assist with monthly expense reconciliation and month-end close preparation

Review QBO monthly and investigate discrepancies or uncategorised transactions

Maintain organised records for invoices, receipts, bills, POs, and other finance documentation

Coordinate with external bookkeepers, accountants, or finance partners where required

Reporting & Reconciliation

Reconcile Cin7 Core activity against QBO

Maintain clear revenue, inventory, and expense records

Identify differences between operational and accounting systems and resolve where possible

Support monthly reporting with accurate data pulls and reconciliations

Flag unusual transactions, missing documents, or inconsistencies promptly



Required Skills & Experience



⚠️ Cin7 Core: Hands-on experience with Cin7 Core is mandatory — candidates without this will not be considered

QuickBooks Online: Strong working experience with QBO across AR, AP, invoicing, expense reconciliation, and month-end processes

Inventory & Operations: Experience working with purchase orders, inventory records, customer pricing, supplier data, SKUs, BOMs/recipes, item mapping, and inventory transactions

Finance Administration: 2+ years in inventory administration, bookkeeping, finance administration, operations, or a similar role

Excel / Google Sheets: Strong skills required for data management and reconciliation work

Accuracy & Organisation: Excellent numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and consistency with recurring finance and operational tasks

Communication: Strong written and spoken English; comfortable working independently across both operational and accounting systems

Industry Background: Experience within CPG, food & beverage, e-commerce, or another physical product business preferred



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: Administration Coordinator | Advanced Claude/AI Skills Required | Electrical/Trade Services
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with genuine, hands-on Claude experience — well beyond basic chat use — will be prioritised. This is close to a non-negotiable requirement for this role, not a nice-to-have.



An electrical trade services business needs a highly organised, process-driven Administration Coordinator to own enquiries, invoicing, payroll inputs, records, and SOP documentation. This is not a receptionist role — the phone is already handled by an automated phone assistant — and it is not a bookkeeping role either; bookkeeping sits permanently with an external bookkeeper. The role is best understood as the connective tissue that turns a business currently run out of a couple of people's heads into one with proper systems behind it.



Every technical, on-the-tools decision is deliberately kept out of this role — it runs on lookup tables, written procedures, and a "draft, show, send" review rule — so success depends on accuracy, follow-through on chasing (invoices, quotes, records), and genuine comfort with writing documentation. Just as important: this business already runs a real chunk of its systems-improvement work through Claude, connected to its core platforms via MCP, and it needs someone who can operate at that level from day one — reading job data, spotting patterns, and building or improving tools and reports with it, not just cleaning up a reply.



The role is deliberately split into two phases: phase one (below) is the job from day one, with phase two — quoting, scheduling, purchasing, vehicle/asset admin, and marketing admin — held back until phase one is running smoothly, expected around November 2026.



Working Hours: 8AM - 4PM AEST



What You'll Own



Enquiries & Job Creation



Triage incoming enquiries from shared inboxes

Forward enquiries into the job management system so the job gets created

Check the customer against existing records before creating a job, to avoid duplicate customer records

Use the correct job template so the job category is set from the start

Chase the photos and information a job needs before it can be quoted

Record how the customer heard about the business



Invoicing (worked twice weekly, oldest first)



Confirm the job is finished and has a work-done description

Capture who attended and the hours on site

Identify the correct payer behind the site record (often not the site itself)

Apply standing service call-out charges where relevant

Apply after-hours, weekend and public holiday loadings

An electrical trade services business needs a highly organised, process-driven Administration Coordinator to own enquiries, invoicing, payroll inputs, records, and SOP documentation. This is not a receptionist role — the phone is already handled by an automated phone assistant — and it is not a bookkeeping role either; bookkeeping sits permanently with an external bookkeeper. The role is best understood as the connective tissue that turns a business currently run out of a couple of people's heads into one with proper systems behind it.

title: Full-Time Business Development & Client Relationship Specialist
description:
Remote | Full-Time | U.S. Central Time Availability



The People’s Company Agency is seeking a confident, organized, and results-driven professional to generate leads, book qualified appointments, follow up with prospects, and manage business relationships.



This person will support The People’s Company Agency, Stephanie Njoku’s personal brand, and Paul Njoku’s personal brand.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Lead Generation & Outreach

• Research prospective clients, business owners, referral partners, and organizations.

• Build accurate prospect lists with relevant contact information.

• Conduct cold calls and approved
 and social media outreach.

• Identify opportunities for educational workshops, speaking engagements, partnerships, and business development.



Appointment Setting & Follow-Up

• Start professional conversations, identify needs, and qualify prospects using our criteria.

• Schedule appointments with the appropriate team member.

• Send confirmations and reminders.

• Follow up with unanswered inquiries, missed appointments, and interested prospects.

• Maintain consistent follow-up without being pushy.



Sales Support & Account Management

• Explain our approved services and next steps clearly.

• Maintain relationships with prospects, clients, and partners.

• Track outstanding requests and coordinate timely responses.

• Support the sales process and hand off product recommendations and regulated discussions to appropriately licensed team members.



GoHighLevel & Organization

• Maintain accurate contact records, notes, tags, tasks, and pipeline stages in GHL.

• Manage booking calendars and follow-up tasks.

• Coordinate with our marketing team so incoming leads receive timely attention.

• Keep records of outreach, appointments, and next steps.



Reporting

• Provide daily activity updates and weekly results.

• Track qualified appointments, attendance, follow-up completion, and opportunities generated.

• Identify obstacles and recommend improvements.



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience in appointment setting, cold calling, lead generation, or business development.

• Clear spoken English and strong professional writing.

• Confidence speaking with business owners and professionals.

• Hands-on GHL experience with contacts, pipelines, calendars, and tasks.

• Strong follow-through, organization, and relationship-building skills.

• Availability during agreed U.S. Central Time calling hours.

• Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a professional headset.



Financial services or professional services experience is preferred.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



Your résumé and desired monthly compensation.



A short voice recording introducing yourself and demonstrating an appointment-setting conversation.



Examples of your previous results, including the type of outreach and how appointments were qualified.



A summary of your GHL experience.



Your availability and earliest start date.



Begin your application with “RELATIONSHIPS + RESULTS.”



Shortlisted applicants will complete an interview and a small paid role-play assessment.

title: Amazon Account Health & Suspension Recovery Specialist
description:
We are looking for a sharp, highly experienced Amazon Account Health & Suspension Specialist to protect, monitor, and rescue our international Amazon Seller Central accounts. In this role, you will act as our primary defense against policy violations, Section 3 suspensions, ASIN blockages, and performance metric drops across global marketplaces (US, UK, EU, etc.).

If you know Amazon’s bureaucratic maze inside out, possess a track record of writing winning Plans of Action (POAs), and know how to deal successfully with Seller Support and internal performance teams, we want you on our team!

Key Responsibilities:

Account Health Monitoring: Daily tracking of Amazon Seller Central Account Health dashboards, warning notifications, performance metrics, and policy compliance flags.

Suspension & Violation Resolution: Spearhead the appeals process for account-level suspensions, restricted/blocked listings, IP complaints, restricted product violations, and authenticity issues.

Plan of Action (POA) Writing: Draft clear, concise, and highly effective root-cause analyses and corrective action plans tailored to Amazon’s stringent compliance requirements.

Seller Support Escalation: Open, manage, and persistently follow up on Seller Support cases until full resolution is achieved.

Listing & Compliance Auditing: Proactively audit product listings, backend keywords, and imagery to prevent policy violations before they trigger automated takedowns.

Documentation & Prevention: Maintain thorough logs of all cases, appeals, and compliance updates, building standard operating procedures (SOPs) to safeguard future account health.

title: Business Development Representative – Consumer Brands & Retail
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a highly motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to drive outbound sales efforts and generate qualified meetings for our leadership team. This role is responsible for identifying high-potential prospects, building targeted lead lists, executing personalized outreach campaigns, and nurturing relationships until opportunities are ready to engage.



Success in this role isn't about sending the highest volume of
s — it's about building genuine relationships, delivering thoughtful outreach, and consistently booking qualified meetings. The ideal candidate has experience selling agency or professional services, understands the nuances of outbound prospecting, and is comfortable testing new outreach strategies to continuously improve performance.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week), with opportunity to increase as the business grows

Time Zone: Must be available during PST business hours

Compensation: 7 USD per hour with 20 USD per qualified attended meeting



Key Responsibilities



1. Prospect Research & Lead Generation



Research and identify high-potential prospects across a variety of growth stages

Build and maintain targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, industry publications, databases, and market research

Monitor buying signals such as fundraising announcements, product launches, and retail expansions to identify new opportunities

Continuously refine lead lists to ensure a healthy and qualified sales pipeline



2. Outbound Sales & Relationship Building



Execute personalized outbound outreach via
, LinkedIn, and where relevant, cold calling

Craft thoughtful, relevant messaging tailored to each prospect rather than relying on generic templates

Manage follow-up sequences and nurture prospects over time

Test new messaging approaches and outreach strategies to improve campaign performance

Book qualified discovery meetings for the leadership team



3. CRM & Pipeline Management



Maintain accurate records within HubSpot, including contact information, outreach history, and pipeline stages

Track prospect engagement, follow-up activities, and meeting outcomes

Ensure all sales activities are documented and opportunities remain organized and up to date

Report on outreach performance, meetings booked, and pipeline activity



4. Continuous Improvement



Share learnings and recommendations to improve outbound strategy and campaign performance

Leverage AI tools and sales technology to improve efficiency, research, and outreach quality

Collaborate with leadership to refine messaging, targeting, and sales processes as the business grows



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: Minimum 2 years in a BDR, SDR, or similar outbound sales role; experience selling services within an agency environment is essential

Outreach: Proven experience generating qualified meetings through outbound prospecting

Communication: Strong written and verbal English communication skills with excellent copywriting and relationship-building abilities

CRM: Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM platforms

Tools: Proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and modern prospecting tools; comfortable leveraging AI tools to improve productivity and sales workflows



To Apply

Kindly send your resume and introduction video
